items.title: 伊朗戰事打半年仍未見出口 小摩傻眼：首次不知道如何建模油市終局
items.title_en: Six Months of Iran Conflict Still No Export Relief, JPMorgan Stunned: First Time We Don’t Know How to Model the Oil‑Market Endgame
paras: 摩根大通周四(17日)表示, 隨著美國與以色列對伊朗的戰事持續已約6個月, 該行目前首次無法為油市建立明確的基準情境, 分析師直言「我們根本不知道該如何建模終局」。摩根大通指出, 衝突持續時間與能源供應受到的衝擊已超出最初假設, 市場目前只能在供應中斷、需求下降及庫存變化之間尋找新的平衡。
摩根大通指出, 戰事初期該行原本假設美國政府存在一些不會跨越的經濟及政治門檻, 但經過半年後, 多項原先認為不太可能突破的界線已經被跨越, 市場至今仍看不到明確的退出策略, 使油價後續走勢更加難以預測。
目前國際油價已突破每桶100美元, 美國汽油價格升至每加侖4.37美元, 柴油價格更創歷史新高, 達每加侖6.31美元。摩根大通指出, 美國柴油市場正進入冬季需求高峰期, 同時庫存已處於歷史低位, 如果中東供應干擾持續, 成品油市場可能面臨更大的價格壓力。
在原油方面, 摩根大通估算9月布蘭特原油(Brent)合理價值約為每桶90美元, 明顯低於目前約106美元的市場價格。該行認為, 目前油價已反映市場對進一步供應損失的風險定價, 亦即市場擔心除了目前估計約每日1,000萬桶的供應受到干擾之外, 後續仍可能出現更多供應中斷。
摩根大通指出, 中東能源供應面臨的風險並不局限於伊朗本身。紅海與曼德海峽的航運安全仍受到威脅, 沙烏地阿拉伯的原油出口路線近期也遭遇攻擊, 同時俄羅斯煉油基礎設施持續受到攻擊, 烏克蘭城市亦遭到襲擊。這些因素共同增加全球能源供應鏈的不確定性。
然而, 值得注意的是, 儘管供應受到的衝擊規模相當龐大, 油價並沒有如摩根大通原先預期般大幅攀升。主要原因在於全球政府與消費者目前較少依靠庫存下降來彌補供應缺口, 而是透過降低能源需求來吸收部分衝擊。
摩根大通估計, 自戰事開始以來, 全球原油及成品油庫存合計減少約5.55億桶, 但這僅相當於該行今年稍早預測降幅的約三分之一。換言之, 實際庫存消耗速度遠低於原先預期, 為油市提供比預期更大的緩衝空間。
與此同時, 全球石油需求目前較去年同期低約每日440萬桶。摩根大通表示, 需求下降成為抵銷供應損失的重要因素, 也解釋了為何即使出現大規模供應中斷, 原油價格仍未持續大幅上漲。
摩根大通指出, 自衝突開始以來, Brent平均價格約為每桶94美元。市場透過「需求破壞」而非大量消耗庫存來維持供需平衡, 使油價在供應受到嚴重干擾的情況下, 仍能避免長時間維持在更高水準。
不過, 這種平衡能否持續仍存在高度不確定性。摩根大通表示, 中國、歐洲、日本及南韓仍持有相當規模的原油及成品油庫存, 可在供應中斷延長的初期階段提供緩衝, 因此油價短期內未必需要大幅上漲才能重新平衡市場。
但如果中東供應中斷持續下去, 情況可能逐步改變。隨著庫存進一步下降, 全球市場將越來越依賴降低需求來維持供需平衡, 屆時油價可能在今年稍晚面臨更大的上行壓力。摩根大通形容, 目前市場仍有足夠的「彈藥」控制油價, 但這種緩衝並非無限。
國際能源署(IEA)上周也表示, 全球石油供應與需求今年可能較此前預期進一步下降, 顯示能源市場正在受到戰事及高油價的雙重影響。另一方面, 石油輸出國組織(OPEC)仍預期今年全球石油需求將成長, 儘管該組織已連續第5個月下調需求成長預估, 目前預估2026年全球石油需求每日增加約38萬桶。
油市近期的價格走勢也反映這種矛盾。周四國際油價連續第2個交易日下跌, 布蘭特原油下跌1.01美元或0.95%, 收每桶104.82美元; 美國西德州中級原油(WTI)下跌52美分或0.5%, 收每桶101.91美元。市場對沙烏地阿拉伯增加原油供應及部分恢復替代輸油路線的預期升溫, 暫時緩解供應中斷疑慮。
因此, 摩根大通目前的核心觀點並非單純預測油價將持續上漲或下跌, 而是認為市場已進入難以建立傳統基準情境的階段。戰事何時結束、荷姆茲海峽及其他重要航道能否恢復正常、沙烏地阿拉伯等主要產油國能否維持出口, 以及全球消費者能承受多高的能源價格, 都將決定供需平衡能否延續。
如果中東供應干擾逐步解除, 目前高於合理價值的油價可能面臨回落壓力; 但若供應損失進一步擴大且庫存開始快速下降, 油市可能需要更高價格來迫使需求進一步降低。對市場而言, 最大的不確定性已從單純的「供應短缺有多嚴重」, 轉變為「這場衝突究竟何時以及以什麼方式結束」。
paras_en: JPMorgan Chase said on Thursday (the 17th) that as the war between the United States and Israel and Iran drags on for about six months, the bank for the first time cannot establish a clear baseline scenario for the oil market, with analysts bluntly stating, “We literally don’t know how to model the endgame.” JPMorgan noted that the duration of the conflict and its impact on energy supply have exceeded original assumptions, and the market can now only seek a new balance among supply disruptions, demand declines and inventory changes.

JPMorgan pointed out that early in the war the firm had assumed the U.S. government would not cross certain economic and political thresholds, but after six months many lines once thought unlikely to be breached have been crossed. The market still sees no clear exit strategy, making oil‑price forecasts even more uncertain.

International oil prices have now broken the $100‑a‑barrel mark, U.S. gasoline has risen to $4.37 per gallon and diesel has hit a historic high of $6.31 per gallon. JPMorgan said the U.S. diesel market is entering its winter‑demand peak while inventories sit at historic lows; if Middle‑East supply disruptions persist, refined‑product markets could face even greater price pressure.

For crude, JPMorgan estimates a fair value for September Brent of about $90 a barrel, well below the roughly $106 a barrel market price. The firm believes current prices already reflect the market’s risk pricing of further supply losses – beyond the estimated 10 million barrels per day currently affected, additional disruptions could follow.

JPMorgan noted that Middle‑East energy‑supply risks are not limited to Iran. Shipping security in the Red Sea and the Strait of Hormuz remains threatened, Saudi Arabia’s export routes have recently been attacked, Russian refining infrastructure continues to be hit, and Ukrainian cities have also been struck. These factors together heighten global energy‑supply‑chain uncertainty.

Nevertheless, it is noteworthy that despite the large scale of supply shocks, oil prices have not surged as JPMorgan originally expected. The main reason is that governments and consumers worldwide are relying less on drawing down inventories to fill the gap and more on cutting energy demand to absorb part of the shock.

JPMorgan estimates that since the war began, global crude and product inventories have fallen by about 555 million barrels, which is only roughly one‑third of the drawdown the firm forecast earlier this year. In other words, the actual rate of inventory consumption is far slower than expected, providing the oil market with a larger buffer than anticipated.

At the same time, global oil demand is currently about 4.4 million barrels per day lower than a year ago. JPMorgan says the demand decline is a key factor offsetting supply losses and explains why even large‑scale supply interruptions have not driven crude prices into a sustained sharp rise.

JPMorgan notes that since the conflict began, Brent’s average price has been about $94 a barrel. The market has maintained supply‑demand balance through “demand destruction” rather than massive inventory drawdowns, allowing prices to avoid staying at higher levels despite severe supply interference.

However, the durability of this balance remains highly uncertain. JPMorgan says China, Europe, Japan and South Korea still hold sizable crude and product inventories that can provide a buffer in the early stages of prolonged supply interruptions, so oil prices may not need to jump sharply in the short term to rebalance the market.

But if Middle‑East supply disruptions continue, the picture could change gradually. As inventories fall further, the global market will rely increasingly on demand cuts to maintain balance, and oil prices could face stronger upward pressure later this year. JPMorgan describes the market as still having enough “ammunition” to control prices, but this buffer is not unlimited.

The International Energy Agency said last week that global oil supply and demand this year may fall further than previously expected, showing that the energy market is being hit by both the war and high oil prices. Meanwhile OPEC still projects global oil demand growth this year, even though the group has cut its demand‑growth forecast for the fifth consecutive month and now estimates an increase of about 380,000 barrels per day by 2026.

Oil‑market price action recently reflects this contradiction. On Thursday, international oil prices fell for the second consecutive trading day, with Brent down $1.01 or 0.95% to $104.82 a barrel and U.S. West Texas Intermediate down 52 cents or 0.5% to $101.91 a barrel. Expectations of increased Saudi supply and partial restoration of alternative shipping routes have temporarily eased supply‑disruption concerns.

Thus JPMorgan’s core view is not simply a forecast of rising or falling oil prices, but that the market has entered a phase where traditional baseline scenarios are hard to construct. When the war ends, whether the Strait of Hormuz and other key chokepoints reopen, whether major producers such as Saudi Arabia can maintain exports, and how high global consumers can tolerate energy prices will all determine whether supply‑demand balance can persist.

If Middle‑East supply disruptions gradually ease, the currently over‑valued oil price may face downward pressure; but if supply losses widen and inventories start to drop rapidly, the market may need higher prices to force further demand cuts. The biggest uncertainty for the market has shifted from “how severe the supply shortage is” to “when and how this conflict will end.”

items.title: 〈貴金屬盤後〉美元和油價攜手下跌 黃金反彈逾2%
items.title_en: <Precious Metals After Hours> Dollar and Oil Prices Fall Together, Gold Rebounds Over 2%
paras: 黃金周四(17日)反彈逾2%，從前一日觸及的近六周低點反彈，主因是油價下跌，美元也下滑，投資人則持續評估聯準會(Fed)周三升息後的利率走向。

黃金現貨上漲2.3%，報每盎司4360.36美元。
美國黃金期貨收高0.3%，報每盎司4399.70美元。


High Ridge Futures金屬交易主管David Meger說：「基於通膨壓力，我們與能源價格一直呈現非常密切的反向關係……能源價格大幅下跌。因此，正是能源價格走低，減輕了金市一部分壓力。」
市場對供應中斷的擔憂減弱，促使油價連續第二個交易日下跌並跌至一周低點。美元則從七周高點回落，使以美元計價的黃金對其他貨幣持有者而言更加便宜。
基準的10年期美國公債殖利率也走低。當美國公債殖利率偏高，會降低黃金這類不孳息資產的吸引力。
Fed周三升息，並釋出未來幾個月可能進一步升息的訊號。Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)加入一致通過升息的決議，反映出川普政府迄今仍無法控制通膨，而決策官員擔心通膨可能進一步惡化。
根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具，交易員目前認為，Fed在10月下一次召開會議時再次升息的機率為51%，高於前一天的近44%。
儘管黃金被視為抗通膨工具，但高利率環境會提高計息資產的吸引力，因而降低黃金的吸引力。
瑞銀(UBS)說：「不斷上升的財政赤字、更高的債務負擔、美元最終走弱，以及我們預期Fed明年將恢復寬鬆政策，應能在短期波動之際支撐金價。」
英國央行(BOE)周四維持利率不變。在此同十，日本銀行(BOJ，央行)預料周五將升息至31年來最高水準，並釋出準備持續推升借貸成本的訊號。

其他貴金屬交易


現貨白銀上漲4.2%，報每盎司65.60美元。
現貨白金上揚1.8%，報每盎司1783.69美元。
現貨鈀金攀升1.6%，報每盎司1289.45美元。
paras_en: Gold rebounded over 2% on Thursday (the 17th), climbing from the near‑six‑week low it hit the day before. The rally was driven mainly by falling oil prices and a weaker dollar, as investors continued to assess the rate‑path after the Fed’s rate hike on Wednesday.

Spot gold rose 2.3% to $4,360.36 per ounce. U.S. gold futures gained 0.3% to $4,399.70 per ounce. High Ridge Futures metals trading head David Meger said: “Because of inflation pressure, we have a very close inverse relationship with energy prices… Energy prices have dropped sharply. So the decline in energy prices has eased some pressure on the gold market.”

Reduced concerns over supply disruptions helped push oil prices down for a second consecutive trading day, taking them to a one‑week low. The dollar also fell from a seven‑week high, making gold priced in dollars cheaper for holders of other currencies.
The benchmark 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield also moved lower. When Treasury yields are high, they diminish the appeal of non‑yielding assets like gold.

The Fed raised rates on Wednesday and signaled that further hikes could come in the next few months. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh joined the unanimous vote to raise rates, reflecting that the Trump administration has yet to curb inflation and that policymakers fear inflation could worsen further.
According to the CME FedWatch tool, traders now see a 51% probability that the Fed will raise rates again at its next meeting in October, up from roughly 44% the day before.
Although gold is viewed as an inflation‑hedge, a high‑interest‑rate environment makes interest‑bearing assets more attractive, thereby reducing gold’s appeal.

UBS said: “Rising fiscal deficits, higher debt burdens, an eventual weakening of the dollar, and our expectation that the Fed will return to easing policy next year should support gold prices amid short‑term volatility.”

The Bank of England kept rates unchanged on Thursday. At the same time, the Bank of Japan is expected to raise rates on Friday to the highest level in 31 years, signaling a continued push to increase borrowing costs.
Other precious metals: Spot silver rose 4.2% to $65.60 per ounce. Spot platinum gained 1.8% to $1,783.69 per ounce. Spot palladium climbed 1.6% to $1,289.45 per ounce.

items.title: 波蘭警告：俄羅斯計劃攻擊烏克蘭的北約盟國
items.title_en: Poland Warns Russia May Target NATO Ally Supporting Ukraine
paras: 多家外媒報導，波蘭總理圖斯克 (Donald Tusk) 週四 (17 日) 表示，根據情報評估，俄羅斯可能以無人機及飛彈攻擊支持烏克蘭的北約盟國，波蘭也在潛在目標之列。俄方可能將攻擊包裝成「意外」，企圖削弱北約成員國共同因應侵略的意願。
圖斯克在國會發表談話時指出，俄羅斯可能對援烏國家發動「混合式無人機及飛彈攻擊」，藉此癱瘓或至少動搖北約國家援引共同防禦條款、聯手應對成員國遭受攻擊的決心。不過，他並未說明相關警告來自哪些情報機構。
歐洲國家懷疑，莫斯科涉及近幾個月發生的一連串破壞行動，意在向協助烏克蘭抵抗俄羅斯全面入侵的國家施壓，其中德國尤其受到關注。克里姆林宮則強烈否認相關指控。
圖斯克進一步警告，俄羅斯可能利用部分歐洲國家的政治變化採取行動。隨著對俄立場較友善的政治勢力擴大影響力，相關政黨可能以追求和平、反對戰爭及避免無謂傷亡為訴求，要求結束戰爭，但最終結果可能是迫使烏克蘭全面投降。
報導指出，圖斯克所指可能包括德國另類選擇黨及法國國民聯盟等對俄立場較友善的政黨。
圖斯克發出警告之際，俄羅斯週四攻擊靠近波蘭邊境的烏克蘭西部地區，促使波蘭出動軍機，並加強領空防禦。
波蘭熱舒夫及盧布林機場一度暫停運作，東部兩個地區的居民也收到空襲警報。當地媒體報導，部分地區響起警報，一些學校安排學生進入避難處所。
圖斯克表示，位於多羅胡斯克附近、距離波蘭邊境極近的一座加油站，很可能再次遭到攻擊。此前，一架俄羅斯無人機週日擊中烏克蘭境內一列客運列車，事發地點距波蘭邊境僅約 2 公里。
波蘭國防部長科西尼亞克－卡梅什 (Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz) 表示，波蘭已增加 F-16 戰機及直升機的出動頻率，並強化防空與快速反應系統，以提升領空防護能力。
美國總統川普週四也表示，美國在波蘭設立陸軍基地的計畫正取得進展；若最終敲定，基地地點將很快公布。他並稱，此舉將成為美波同盟的歷史性一步。
與此同時，美國眾議院週三通過一項法案，授權川普對俄羅斯石油的主要進口國徵收最高 100% 關稅，企圖遏止中國及印度等國購買俄羅斯能源。這是川普重返白宮以來，美國支持烏克蘭最重大的立法行動，也打破援烏議題近兩年來的相對僵局。
圖斯克預定週五訪問烏克蘭，與烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基討論「整合反彈道飛彈聯盟」合作。該聯盟由多個歐洲國家與烏克蘭共同推動防空系統研發，目標是打造成本低於美製愛國者系統的替代方案。
paras_en: Multiple foreign media reported that Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said on Thursday the 17th that, based on intelligence assessments, Russia could use drones and missiles to attack NATO allies supporting Ukraine, with Poland also listed among potential targets. Moscow might frame such attacks as "accidents" to undermine NATO members' willingness to respond collectively to aggression.

Tusk told parliament that Russia may launch a "hybrid drone and missile attack" against countries aiding Ukraine, aiming to cripple or at least shake NATO's resolve to invoke the collective defence clause and act together when a member is attacked. He did not specify which intelligence agencies provided the warning.

European nations suspect Moscow is behind a series of sabotage actions in recent months intended to pressure countries assisting Ukraine in resisting Russia's full‑scale invasion, with Germany drawing particular scrutiny. The Kremlin strongly denies the allegations.

Tusk further warned that Russia could exploit political shifts in some European states to act. As parties with a more Russia‑friendly stance gain influence, they may campaign on peace, anti‑war and casualty‑avoidance slogans, calling for an end to the war, but the ultimate effect could be to force Ukraine's total surrender.
The report noted that the parties Tusk referred to may include Germany's Alternative for Germany and France's National Rally, both seen as more friendly toward Russia.
Tusk issued his warning as Russia attacked Ukraine’s western region near the Polish border on Thursday, prompting Poland to scramble aircraft and bolster its air‑defence posture.

Poland’s Rzeszów and Lublin airports were temporarily shut, and residents in two eastern regions received air‑raid alerts. Local media said alarms sounded in some areas and schools moved students to shelters.

Tusk said a fuel station near Dorohusk, very close to the Polish border, is likely to be hit again. Previously, a Russian drone struck a passenger train inside Ukraine on Sunday at a location only about two kilometres from the Polish border.

Polish Defence Minister Wladyslaw Kosiniak‑Kamysz said Poland has increased the sortie rate of F‑16 fighters and helicopters and has reinforced air‑defence and rapid‑response systems to improve air‑space protection.

U.S. President Donald Trump also said on Thursday that the plan to establish an American army base in Poland is making progress; once finalized, the site will be announced soon, calling the move a historic step for the U.S.–Poland alliance.

At the same time, the U.S. House of Representatives passed a bill on Wednesday authorising Trump to levy up to a 100% tariff on Russia’s main oil importers, aiming to curb China’s and India’s purchases of Russian energy. This is the most significant U.S. legislative support for Ukraine since Trump returned to the White House and breaks a near‑two‑year stalemate on aid to Ukraine.

Tusk is scheduled to visit Ukraine on Friday to discuss cooperation on an "integrated anti‑ballistic‑missile alliance" with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy. The alliance, driven by several European countries and Ukraine, seeks to develop a lower‑cost alternative to the U.S. Patriot system for air‑defence.

items.title: 美中AI競爭升溫 FBI甫指控阿里巴巴仿製Anthropic 美政府網站急撤Qwen
items.title_en: U.S.-China AI Competition Heats Up as FBI Accuses Alibaba of Copying Anthropic; U.S. Government Site Pulls Qwen
paras: 美國聯邦政府一個官方網站近日被發現曾採用中國人工智慧模型進行搜尋, 而就在數日前, 美國聯邦調查局(FBI)才指控該模型開發商阿里巴巴(9988-HK)涉嫌「惡意」複製美國AI公司Anthropic的技術, 事件再度凸顯美中AI競爭升溫之際, 美國政府對中國AI工具的使用所引發的安全與政策爭議。
美國國家檔案暨文書總署(National Archives)旗下的Federal Register網站周三(16日)被發現提供由阿里巴巴Qwen模型支援的AI搜尋工具, 讓使用者搜尋聯邦政府提出的法規及瀏覽相關公眾意見。路透社檢視網站截圖及保存的網站原始碼後確認, Qwen搜尋功能當時與其他搜尋選項並列, 但目前無法確認該工具究竟何時上線。
在社群媒體出現相關貼文的同時,Qwen支援的搜尋功能也於周三遭到撤下。美國國家檔案暨文書總署及白宮未回覆路透社置評要求,FBI周四也拒絕評論此次Qwen工具遭撤下的情況。
此次事件受到關注的背景之一, 是FBI上周指控阿里巴巴複製Anthropic的AI模型, 用於建立自身AI工具。美國官員當時表示, 中國AI企業正在以「工業規模」惡意複製美國科技, 使華府與北京之間原已緊張的AI競爭進一步升溫。
美國政府網站使用Qwen的消息, 正值全球持續討論AI安全風險之際, 美國國內也正在辯論是否需要進一步建立AI監管措施。一方面, 支持監管者認為需要防範先進AI可能產生的安全風險; 另一方面, 部分人士則擔心過度監管可能削弱美國企業在全球AI競爭中的發展速度。
Qwen屬於「開放權重」AI模型, 意味著模型的重要組成部分可以公開取得, 開發者可以下載並修改模型, 依照自身需求部署。相較於Anthropic及OpenAI等採用封閉模型的公司, 開放權重模型通常可以降低部分使用成本, 同時讓企業或政府機構有機會直接在自身IT基礎設施上運行模型。
安全專家指出, 如果開放權重模型直接部署在使用者自己的IT環境內, 組織可以對敏感資料保有更高控制權, 不必將相關資料直接傳送給外部AI服務商。因此, AI專家認為, Federal Register使用Qwen本身未必構成立即性的國家安全風險。
Georgetown Law教授Anupam Chander表示, 從目前情況來看,Qwen被部署在Federal Register網站上似乎沒有立即造成網路安全風險, 但實際風險仍取決於模型如何訓練及部署。Federal Register網站主要提供政府新提出的法規及相關公開內容, 這些資料本身已屬公開資訊, 因此Qwen當時並非用於處理機密政府資料。
不過, 美國參議院情報委員會副主席Mark Warner則指出, 真正的安全風險取決於美國政府資料是否離開政府的安全邊界, 以及相關資料是否被送往由阿里巴巴控制的系統進行處理。換言之, 模型本身是否來自中國並非唯一考量, 實際部署方式、資料流向及運算環境同樣是評估風險的重要因素。
Federal Register主要負責發布美國聯邦政府新提出的法規、規則及相關官方資訊, 此次Qwen工具則被提供作為瀏覽公眾意見的搜尋工具。從目前資訊來看, 其主要處理的是Federal Register網站上的公開資料, 而非政府機密文件。
事件也引發外界對美國政府AI政策一致性的討論。Information Technology and Innovation Foundation主席Daniel Castro指出, 美國政府一方面正與中國激烈競爭AI技術優勢, 另一方面卻有聯邦機構選擇中國開發的AI模型, 兩者之間存在明顯落差。
除了Federal Register, 中國AI模型進入美國民間平台也受到國會關注。今年4月, 美國眾議院中國問題特別委員會及國土安全委員會曾致函Airbnb(AIRBNB-US), 要求該公司說明使用Qwen的情況。國會當時針對中國AI工具被整合至美國民眾使用的平台所可能產生的國家安全風險展開調查。
此次事件發生在美中兩國領導人預計於下周會面的敏感時間點。隨著AI模型能力快速提升, 美國政府不僅關注中國企業在AI技術上的發展, 也開始更加重視中國AI模型在美國企業及政府系統中的部署情況。
目前沒有證據顯示Federal Register使用Qwen造成資料外洩或其他具體安全事件, AI專家也指出, 由於該網站主要處理公開資訊, 目前看不到立即性的國家安全威脅。然而, 在美國政府持續對中國AI企業及其技術來源提出安全與智慧財產權疑慮的背景下, 聯邦政府機構採用中國AI模型的做法, 仍可能引發更多對資料流向、模型訓練來源及政府科技採購政策的討論。
paras_en: The U.S. federal government’s official website was recently found to have used a Chinese AI model for search, and just days earlier the FBI accused the model’s developer, Alibaba (9988-HK), of "maliciously" copying technology from U.S. AI company Anthropic, highlighting security and policy disputes over the use of Chinese AI tools amid rising U.S.-China AI rivalry.

The Federal Register site, operated by the National Archives, was discovered on Wednesday (the 16th) to offer an AI‑powered search tool supported by Alibaba’s Qwen model, allowing users to search federal regulations and view related public comments. Reuters, after reviewing screenshots and archived source code, confirmed that the Qwen search option was listed alongside other search choices, though it cannot determine when the tool was first launched.

At the same time the related social‑media posts appeared, the Qwen‑powered search feature was taken down on Wednesday. Neither the National Archives nor the White House responded to Reuters’ request for comment, and the FBI declined to comment on the removal on Thursday.

One reason the episode drew attention is that the FBI last week charged Alibaba with copying Anthropic’s AI model to build its own tools. U.S. officials said Chinese AI firms are maliciously replicating American technology on an "industrial scale," further heating an already tense AI competition between Washington and Beijing.

The news that a U.S. government site used Qwen comes as global debate over AI safety risks continues, and domestic discussions in the United States about whether additional AI regulation is needed. Pro‑regulation advocates argue that safeguards are required to prevent advanced AI from creating security threats, while some worry that over‑regulation could slow U.S. firms in the global AI race.

Qwen is an "open‑weight" AI model, meaning key components of the model are publicly available; developers can download, modify, and deploy it according to their needs. Compared with companies like Anthropic and OpenAI that use closed models, open‑weight models can lower some usage costs and give enterprises or government agencies the chance to run the model on their own IT infrastructure.

Security experts note that if an open‑weight model is deployed within an organization’s own IT environment, the entity retains greater control over sensitive data and does not need to send that data to an external AI provider. Therefore, they say the Federal Register’s use of Qwen does not necessarily constitute an immediate national‑security risk.

Georgetown Law professor Anupam Chander said that, based on what is known, Qwen’s deployment on the Federal Register site does not appear to pose an immediate cyber‑security threat, but the actual risk depends on how the model is trained and deployed. The site mainly provides newly proposed regulations and related public content, which are already public information, so Qwen was not being used to process classified government data.

However, Senate Intelligence Committee vice‑chair Mark Warner warned that the real security risk hinges on whether U.S. government data leaves the secure government perimeter and is sent to systems controlled by Alibaba for processing. In other words, the model’s Chinese origin is not the sole factor; deployment method, data flows, and computing environment are also critical to risk assessment.

The Federal Register is responsible for publishing new federal regulations, rules, and official information, and the Qwen tool was offered as a search aid for browsing public comments. From the available information, it appears to handle only the site’s publicly available material, not classified government documents.

The episode has sparked discussion about the consistency of U.S. government AI policy. Daniel Castro, chair of the Information Technology and Innovation Foundation, pointed out the paradox that while the U.S. government fiercely competes with China for AI leadership, some federal agencies are still opting for Chinese‑developed AI models, revealing a clear mismatch.

Beyond the Federal Register, Chinese AI models entering private U.S. platforms have also drawn congressional scrutiny. In April, the House China Task Force and the Homeland Security Committee wrote to Airbnb (AIRBNB‑US) requesting an explanation of its use of Qwen, launching an investigation into potential national‑security risks from Chinese AI tools integrated into platforms used by Americans.

The incident occurs at a sensitive moment, with U.S. and Chinese leaders slated to meet next week. As AI model capabilities rapidly advance, the U.S. government is not only monitoring Chinese corporate AI developments but also paying increasing attention to the deployment of Chinese AI models within American companies and government systems.

There is currently no evidence that the Federal Register’s use of Qwen caused data leaks or any concrete security incidents, and AI experts say that because the site primarily handles public information, no immediate national‑security threat is evident. Nonetheless, amid ongoing U.S. concerns over the security and intellectual‑property implications of Chinese AI firms and their technologies, the adoption of Chinese AI models by federal agencies could spur further debate over data flows, model‑training sources, and government tech‑procurement policies.

items.title: AI基建亮點股！Applied Digital大漲8% 獲富國銀行列首選股
items.title_en: AI Infrastructure Highlight Stock! Applied Digital Jumps 8% as Wells Fargo Names It a Top Pick
paras: 《Benzinga》報導，資料中心營運商Applied Digital(APLD-US)股價周四(17日)大漲8%，整體股市反彈帶動AI基礎設施與數位託管服務商同步上揚。
周四漲勢受到大型券商力挺的推動。富國銀行(Wells Fargo)當日發布報告，將Applied Digital股票列為首選股(Top Idea)，並開始對該股進行追蹤，給予50美元目標價。該股收四收盤報每股26.38美元。
富國銀行在報告中強調，Applied Digital具備結構性的競爭優勢，包括能取得電力公用事業配額，以及取得高密度AI工作負載所需的數GW規模場址電網併接能力。
報告特別指出，該公司擁有電力優勢的據點，相較之下所面臨的監管風險較低。
此外，富國銀行此次開始追蹤也凸顯Applied Digital投資級客戶組成的積壓訂單品質。該公司的積壓訂單包括與超大規模雲端業者(hyperscaler)簽訂的360億美元長期「無條件支付(take-or-pay)」租賃協議。若客戶行使續約選擇權，30年期間的合約總額最高可達860億美元。
富國銀行指出，Applied Digital目前股價相較於其已簽約淨資產價值及未來數年的營收能見度，存在明顯折價。
事實上，分析師估計，光是這些已簽訂的合約，以淨現值計算，每股價值約30美元，為該股短期重新評價、估值上修提供了有利條件。
paras_en: Benzinga reported that data center operator Applied Digital (APLD-US) saw its stock surge 8% on Thursday the 17th, as a broad market rebound lifted AI infrastructure and digital hosting service providers alike.

The Thursday rally was driven by strong backing from a major broker. Wells Fargo released a report that day naming Applied Digital a Top Idea, began tracking the stock and set a $50 price target. The shares closed at $26.38 each.

Wells Fargo emphasized in the report that Applied Digital enjoys structural competitive advantages, including access to utility power allocations and the ability to connect gigawatt‑scale sites needed for high‑density AI workloads.
The report highlighted that the company’s power‑rich locations face comparatively lower regulatory risk.

Wells Fargo also noted that its new coverage underscores the quality of Applied Digital’s backlog from investment‑grade customers, which includes a $36 billion long‑term take‑or‑pay lease agreement with hyperscale cloud providers. If customers exercise renewal options, the total contract value over 30 years could reach up to $86 billion.
Wells Fargo pointed out that Applied Digital’s current share price is markedly discounted relative to the net asset value of its signed contracts and the revenue visibility for the coming years.
Analysts estimate that just these signed contracts have a net present value of about $30 per share, providing a favorable catalyst for a short‑term re‑rating and valuation uplift.

items.title: 殖利率壓不下來 美債這鍋「毒湯」裡到底煮了什麼？
items.title_en: Yield Can't Be Driven Down: What Exactly Is Brewing in the 'Toxic Soup' of U.S. Treasuries?
paras: 美國公債市場是全球規模最大的債券市場之一，每日交易量高達 1.2 兆美元。由於規模龐大，美債市場也成為美國經濟的強力鏡像，反映來自各方的風險，包括通膨、戰爭、財政赤字以及人口結構危機。
近期，美國部分最受關注的公債殖利率明顯攀升，顯示市場對這些風險的擔憂正在升溫。
30 年期美債殖利率近期升至 20 年來高點，10 年期美債殖利率則攀升超過 0.5 個百分點。10 年期美債是房貸、汽車貸款以及部分商業信貸的重要基準，其走勢受到市場高度關注。
殖利率持續攀升令美國財長貝森特（Scott Bessent）感到不安。他已投入數十億美元推動債券回購，希望壓低利率，但這項措施遭到不少經濟學家與金融業人士批評，且截至目前並未真正奏效。
AI熱潮支撐經濟 債市仍面臨多重壓力
美國經濟目前的基本面仍相對強勁，失業率維持歷史低檔，市場對經濟衰退的擔憂也因人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮帶動的大規模支出而減弱。
但究竟是什麼因素正在擾動債券市場？耶魯大學預算實驗室（Budget Lab at Yale University）執行主任金博爾（Martha Gimbel）表示，市場憂慮來自多項因素交織，「它們彼此纏繞，形成一鍋有毒的混合物」。
其中一項主要因素就是美國聯邦債務。截至 8 月中旬，美國聯邦債務正式突破 40 兆美元。對於關注財政紀律的「財政鷹派」而言，最令人擔憂的是，過去 20 年美國債務增長速度已超越經濟成長。
自 2006 年以來，美國聯邦總債務增加近 5 倍，但國內生產毛額（GDP）增幅不到 2.5 倍。
資產管理公司阿波羅全球管理首席經濟學家斯洛克（Torsten Slok）在電子報中指出，「債務累積速度超過支撐償還債務的經濟成長速度」，美國債務占 GDP 比率已從當時不到 40%，升至目前約 100%。
赤字擴大成兩黨問題 財政路線引發市場疑慮
美國財政問題的根源部分來自華府政治人物，包括兩黨都難辭其咎。長期以來，政治人物逐漸接受規模愈來愈大的預算赤字。
喬治華盛頓大學（George Washington University）經濟系主任辛克萊（Tara Sinclair）表示，她可以接受經濟低迷或危機時期出現赤字，「但我們不能永遠一再堆疊債務」。
美國總統川普則認為，美國可以透過經濟成長解決債務問題。他在 8 月表示：「解決債務的方法就是成長，而我們正擁有非常強勁的成長。我們從未有過像現在這樣的成長。」
不過，多數經濟學家認為，政治人物不應提出過於簡化的解決方案，因為美國最終仍可能需要面對債務問題帶來的成本。
其中一種方式是大量印鈔，用資金償還債務，但其副作用可能十分嚴重，包括美元貶值以及通膨升溫，也可能削弱投資人信心。畢竟，投資人不會願意購買一個國家的 10 年期公債，而該國貨幣價值可能因物價失控而大幅下降。
另一種方式則是削減支出，以縮小財政赤字，但這可能涉及削減社會安全、醫療保險等福利計畫以及其他政府服務。
英國與希臘的經驗顯示，大規模緊縮政策可能嚴重影響民眾生活品質、拖累經濟成長，並削弱政府運作能力，也可能導致執政黨承受政治壓力。
美債難安的關鍵變數：聯準會下一步怎麼走
金博爾表示，全球市場近期高度關注華許的動向，也凸顯聯準會在整體市場中的重要性。華許的一言一行，甚至沉默不語，都可能影響美國債券市場，而美債市場又牽動全球債市。
她指出，如果市場認為聯準會未來不像過去那樣可靠，或政策效果可能減弱，投資人就必須將這項風險反映在債券價格中。
不過，影響市場的不只是政府支出增加與央行政策。
長期以來，美國公債被視為全球各類債務中信用品質最高的資產，即使面對貿易戰、債務上限爭議以及政治角力，市場仍普遍認為，美國擁有貨幣發行能力，幾乎不可能違約。
金博爾表示：「目前還沒有其他地方能提供同等程度的安全性與便利性。難道你要把資金放到法國嗎？」
科技巨頭崛起 美債面臨新的安全資產競爭
然而，如今美國公債正面臨不同以往的競爭者。
根據彭博計算，過去 5 年，美國資料中心投資規模最大的 5 家企業：Alphabe(GOOGL-US) 、亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、Meta(META-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 與甲骨文(ORCL-US) ，合計增加約 4120 億美元債務。
其中數家公司擁有媲美國家的資產負債表，以及極高的信用評等。這意味著投資人如今有更多選擇，可以將資金配置在高安全性的資產，因此美國政府可能必須提供更高報酬率，才能與其他債券發行人競爭。
美債殖利率走向仍存變數
未來，美國公債殖利率是否會在高檔維持更長時間，進一步推升政府借貸成本、房貸以及其他信貸成本，或者在沃許政策立場偏向鷹派，或 AI 能夠證明足以帶動經濟成長、協助改善債務問題後回落，仍難以判斷。
不過，辛克萊並不擔心全球投資人會突然失去對美債的需求。她表示，美國在全球貿易與金融體系中的核心地位，意味著全世界都希望美國避免出現重大金融危機，「所有人都會試圖阻止這種情況發生」。
換句話說，美國債券市場如今規模龐大，對全球經濟的重要性極高，已經達到「大到不能倒」的程度。
paras_en: The U.S. Treasury market is one of the world’s largest bond markets, with daily trading volume reaching $1.2 trillion. Because of its sheer size, the market serves as a powerful mirror of the U.S. economy, reflecting risks from inflation, wars, fiscal deficits and demographic challenges.
Recently, yields on several of the most closely watched U.S. government bonds have risen sharply, indicating growing market anxiety about these risks.

The 30‑year Treasury yield has climbed to a 20‑year high, while the 10‑year yield has jumped more than 0.5 percentage points. The 10‑year note is a key benchmark for mortgages, auto loans and many commercial credit products, so its movement draws intense market attention.

The rising yields have unsettled Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent. He has deployed tens of billions of dollars in bond buybacks to try to push rates lower, but the move has drawn criticism from many economists and finance professionals and, so far, has not produced the desired effect.
AI hype supports the economy, but the bond market still faces multiple pressures
U.S. economic fundamentals remain relatively strong, with unemployment at historic lows, and concerns about a recession have eased as AI‑driven investment sprees have spurred large‑scale spending.

But what exactly is unsettling the bond market? Martha Gimbel, director of the Budget Lab at Yale University, says the worries stem from a mix of intertwined factors that “tangle together into a toxic brew.”

One major factor is the federal debt. By mid‑August, the U.S. federal debt officially breached $40 trillion. For fiscally‑conservative “hawkish” observers, the biggest worry is that debt growth over the past two decades has outpaced economic growth.
Since 2006, total federal debt has risen almost five‑fold, while GDP has grown less than 2.5‑fold.

Torsten Slok, chief economist at Apollo Global Management, noted in a newsletter that “the debt is accumulating faster than the economy can grow to service it,” with the debt‑to‑GDP ratio climbing from under 40% back then to roughly 100% today.
Deficits widening become a bipartisan issue, raising market doubts about fiscal direction
The root of America’s fiscal problem lies partly with Washington politicians, and both parties share responsibility. Over time, lawmakers have become accustomed to ever‑larger budget deficits.
Tara Sinclair, chair of the economics department at George Washington University, says she can accept deficits during downturns or crises, “but we cannot keep piling up debt forever.”

Former President Donald Trump argues the U.S. can solve its debt problem through growth. In August he said, “The solution to debt is growth, and we have very strong growth. We’ve never had growth like this.”
Most economists, however, warn that politicians should not offer overly simplistic fixes, because the U.S. will eventually have to face the costs of its debt burden.

One option is massive money printing to pay down debt, but its side effects could be severe, including a weaker dollar, higher inflation and eroded investor confidence. After all, investors won’t buy a country’s 10‑year bonds if its currency is expected to lose value dramatically due to runaway prices.
Another approach is cutting spending to shrink the fiscal deficit, which could involve reductions to Social Security, Medicare and other welfare programs as well as various government services.

The experiences of the U.K. and Greece show that large‑scale austerity can severely affect living standards, drag on growth and weaken governmental capacity, potentially exposing the ruling party to political pressure.
Key variable for shaky Treasuries: what the Fed does next

Gimbel says global markets are closely watching the Fed’s moves, underscoring the central bank’s importance to the overall market. Every word—or even silence—from the Fed can sway the U.S. bond market, which in turn influences global debt markets.
She notes that if investors begin to doubt the Fed’s future reliability or the effectiveness of its policies, they will have to price that risk into bond yields.
However, it’s not only higher government spending and central‑bank policy that affect the market.

For decades, U.S. Treasuries have been viewed as the highest‑quality credit among global debt instruments. Even amid trade wars, debt‑ceiling battles and political fights, markets generally believe the U.S. can issue currency at will and is virtually incapable of defaulting.
Gimbel adds, “There’s currently no other place that can offer the same level of safety and convenience. Are you really going to put your money in France?”
Tech giants rise, creating new competition for Treasuries as safe assets
Now, U.S. Treasuries face competition unlike before.

Bloomberg estimates that over the past five years the five biggest U.S. data‑center investors—Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US), Meta (META‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and Oracle (ORCL‑US)—have collectively added about $412 billion of debt.

Some of these firms have balance sheets comparable to sovereigns and enjoy very high credit ratings, meaning investors now have more high‑quality options and the U.S. government may need to offer higher yields to compete with other issuers.
Treasury yield trajectory still uncertain

Going forward, it remains unclear whether Treasury yields will stay elevated for an extended period—pushing up government borrowing costs, mortgage rates and other credit costs—or whether a more hawkish Fed stance or AI‑driven growth that helps solve the debt issue will cause yields to retreat.

Sinclair, however, is not worried that global investors will suddenly abandon Treasuries. She points out that America’s central role in global trade and finance means the world wants the U.S. to avoid a major financial crisis, “everyone will try to prevent that from happening.”
In other words, the U.S. bond market is now so massive and vital to the global economy that it has become “too big to fail.”

items.title: 10年期美債殖利率回落至4.93% 分析師：最劇烈賣壓已過
items.title_en: 10-year US Treasury Yield Falls to 4.93% – Analysts Say the Sharpest Selling Pressure Is Over
paras: 《CNBC》報導，聯準會 (Fed) 啟動逾3年來首次升息後，美債殖利率週四 (17 日) 全線回落，分析師認為，美債市場此輪最劇烈的價格調整可能已經過去，當前較高的殖利率水準為投資人提供鎖定收益的機會。
10年期美債殖利率下跌逾7個基點至4.93%，30年期殖利率下跌逾6個基點至5.282%；對貨幣政策較敏感的2年期殖利率也下滑逾5個基點至4.67%。債券價格與殖利率走勢相反。
Fed週三以12比0一致決議升息1碼，將聯邦資金利率目標區間上調至3.75%至4%，為2023年7月以來首次升息。由於近期通膨數據持續偏高，加上債市承壓，市場事前已普遍預期Fed將採取行動。
Fed主席華許在會後記者會上表示，通膨過高的情況已持續太久。Fed必須確信基礎通膨正明確且以足夠快的速度回到政策目標，但聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 認為目前尚未達到這項標準。
最新利率點狀圖顯示，18名決策官員中有16人預期今年還會升息。其中，12人預期再升息1碼，另有4人認為可能再升息2碼。
Edwards Asset Management投資長Bob Edwards表示，債市此輪最大幅度的波動可能已經過去。經歷近期價格調整後，投資人目前有機會鎖定較高殖利率。
他預期，Fed若今年再次升息，時間可能落在12月。由於10月會議距離美國期中選舉僅數日，Fed可能避免在該次會議調整利率，以免外界認為政策決定具有政治考量。
市場同時關注華許與川普之間的互動。川普持續要求Fed降息，主張美國利率應降至1%或更低，並批評Fed理事會「非常敵對、非常政治化」，正在採取錯誤行動。
經濟數據方面，截至9月12日當週，美國初領失業救濟金人數為19.6萬人，低於道瓊調查經濟學家預估的20.7萬人，顯示勞動市場仍具韌性；8月新屋開工數則低於市場預期。
paras_en: CNBC reported that after the Federal Reserve’s first rate hike in more than three years, US Treasury yields fell across the board on Thursday (the 17th). Analysts believe the most intense price adjustment in the Treasury market may be behind us, and the current relatively high yield levels offer investors an opportunity to lock in returns.

The 10-year Treasury yield dropped more than 7 basis points to 4.93%, while the 30-year yield fell over 6 basis points to 5.282%. The 2-year yield, which is more sensitive to monetary policy, also slipped more than 5 basis points to 4.67%. Bond prices move inversely to yields.

The Fed voted unanimously 12‑0 on Wednesday to raise rates by one quarter point, moving the federal funds target range to 3.75%‑4%, its first hike since July 2023. With recent inflation data remaining elevated and bond markets under pressure, markets had broadly expected the Fed to act.

Fed Chair Jerome Powell said in the post‑meeting press conference that inflation has been too high for too long. The Fed must be confident that core inflation is clearly moving back toward the policy target at a sufficiently rapid pace, but the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) believes that standard has not yet been met.

The latest rate dot‑plot shows that out of 18 policymakers, 16 expect at least one more hike this year. Twelve anticipate another 25‑basis‑point increase, while four think a 50‑basis‑point hike is possible.

Bob Edwards, Chief Investment Officer at Edwards Asset Management, said the biggest wave of volatility in the bond market may have passed. After the recent price adjustment, investors now have a chance to lock in higher yields.

He expects that if the Fed raises rates again this year, it will likely happen in December. Because the October meeting falls just days before the U.S. midterm elections, the Fed may avoid adjusting rates at that meeting to prevent the perception that the decision is politically motivated.

Markets are also watching the interaction between Powell and former President Trump. Trump continues to urge the Fed to cut rates, arguing that U.S. rates should fall to 1% or lower, and he has criticized the Fed Board as “very hostile, very politicized,” saying it is taking the wrong actions.

On the economic data side, for the week ending September 12, initial unemployment claims in the United States were 196,000, below the Dow Jones economists’ forecast of 207,000, indicating continued labor‑market resilience; meanwhile, August new‑home starts came in below market expectations.

items.title: SpaceX大漲5%後續走高 AI需求並未放緩
items.title_en: SpaceX jumps 5% and continues higher as AI demand remains strong
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，AI需求就是沒有放緩，而SpaceX(SPCX-US)股價周四(17日)再度上漲。
馬斯克(Elon Musk)旗下這家火箭與AI公司股價周四上漲2.6%，至154.81美元。同期標普500指數與道瓊工業平均指數分別上漲1.1%與0.6%。
SpaceX周三已大漲5.2%。公司安排旗下大型可完全重複使用火箭Starship進行第14次試飛，這項消息可能也對股價有所提振。最初預定的發射日期為9月22日，根據公司網站，目前已改定於9月28日進行。
有關SK海力士(SK Hynix)正與英特爾(INTC-US)洽談在美國生產記憶體晶片的報導，也可能推升SpaceX股價。
花旗分析師Atif Malik周三寫道，「這些討論可能代表英特爾擴大與SpaceX合作關係的又一步。」
他表示，「SK海力士/英特爾可能提供位於美國的記憶體製造能力，與英特爾14A製程及先進封裝業務形成互補。」
SpaceX正與特斯拉(TSLA-US)在德州奧斯汀共同興建晶片製造設施，因公司認為，半導體供應最終可能成為AI成長的瓶頸。
SpaceX的成長表現已多次超出市場預期。市場預估SpaceX 2027年的AI營收將達約670億美元，而6月時的預估僅為380億美元。
此外，華爾街目前預期SpaceX 2030年的AI營收將達約2,750億美元，6月時的預估則約為1,100億美元。
根據花旗美國投資級信用策略主管Daniel Sorid，截至第二季末，大型雲端服務商的積壓訂單約達2.5兆美元，可作為AI需求的代理指標，年增約100%，相比2022年底ChatGPT推出前不到5,000億美元的水準大幅增加。
第二季雲端營收首次突破1,000億美元。資料中心資本支出也首次超過1,000億美元。
當然，持續成長的AI需求對SpaceX而言是利多。SpaceX第二季末擁有1.4GW的AI運算能力。(運算能力通常以維持運作所需的電力來衡量。)SpaceX希望到2027年底，AI算力最高可達10GW。
要準確判斷究竟是什麼因素正推動SpaceX股價並不容易。自6月IPO以來，該股一直相當波動，上市初期最高曾達225.64美元，最低則跌至104.83美元。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that AI demand has not slowed, and SpaceX (SPCX-US) stock rose again on Thursday the 17th.
Elon Musk’s rocket and AI company saw its shares climb 2.6% on Thursday to $154.81, while the S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 1.1% and 0.6% respectively.

SpaceX had already surged 5.2% on Wednesday. The company scheduled its large fully reusable Starship rocket for its 14th test flight, a development that may have buoyed the stock. The launch was originally set for Sept. 22 but, according to the company website, has been moved to Sept. 28.
Reports that SK Hynix is in talks with Intel (INTC-US) about producing memory chips in the United States may also be lifting SpaceX’s share price.
Citi analyst Atif Malik wrote on Wednesday that “these discussions could represent another step in Intel expanding its partnership with SpaceX.”
He added that “SK Hynix/Intel could provide U.S.-based memory manufacturing capacity that complements Intel’s 14A process and advanced packaging business.”
SpaceX is jointly building a chip‑manufacturing facility in Austin, Texas with Tesla (TSLA-US), as the company believes semiconductor supply could ultimately become a bottleneck for AI growth.
SpaceX’s growth has repeatedly outpaced market expectations. The market projects SpaceX’s AI revenue to reach roughly $67 billion in 2027, up from a June estimate of $38 billion.
Wall Street now expects SpaceX’s AI revenue to hit about $275 billion by 2030, compared with a June forecast of roughly $110 billion.

According to Citi’s U.S. investment‑grade credit strategy head Daniel Sorid, as of the end of Q2 large cloud providers had backlog orders of about $2.5 trillion, a proxy for AI demand that grew about 100% year‑over‑year, far above the sub‑$500 billion level before ChatGPT’s launch at the end of 2022.
Q2 cloud revenue broke $100 billion for the first time, and data‑center capital spending also exceeded $100 billion for the first time.

Sustained AI demand is clearly a tailwind for SpaceX. The company had 1.4 GW of AI compute capacity at the end of Q2 (compute capacity is typically measured by the power needed to run it). SpaceX aims to reach up to 10 GW of AI compute power by the end of 2027.
Pinpointing the exact drivers behind SpaceX’s stock moves is difficult. Since its June IPO, the share has been volatile, hitting a high of $225.64 early on and a low of $104.83.

items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Pre‑Market Highlights: Futures Surge Past 47,000, Central Bank Holds Rates and Eases Housing Credit
paras: 台股盤前要聞

paras_en: Taiwan Stock Market Pre‑Market News

1. The Taiwan index closed at 46,288 points on the 17th, up 439.1 points, reclaiming the 46,000‑point threshold. Turnover rose to NT$819.405 billion, with foreign investors switching from net selling to net buying, netting a purchase of NT$12.185 billion. Their biggest buys were 53,000 shares of AU Optronics and 33,000 shares of Powerchip Semiconductor. The four major U.S. indices rallied sharply during the session, and Taiwan futures jumped nearly 700 points in after‑hours trading, briefly reaching 47,161 points. TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) rose more than 2%.

2. Although the U.S. Federal Reserve just announced a 25‑basis‑point rate hike, whether Taiwan will follow has sparked debate domestically. The Central Bank held its policy rate steady at the “10‑year freeze” during its Q3 board meeting on the 17th, with Governor Yang Jin‑long saying, “We will walk our own path.” At the same time, the bank relaxed selective credit controls on the housing market, raising the maximum loan‑to‑value ratio for a second home from 60% to 70%.

3. On the 17th, the Central Bank raised its forecast for Taiwan’s second‑half GDP growth to 9.09%, lifting the full‑year GDP estimate to 11.48%. It projects next year’s GDP at 5.82%. Inflation forecasts were also upgraded, with this year’s CPI and core‑CPI annual growth now expected at 2.03% and 2.16% respectively, indicating price pressures remain above the 2% warning line.

4. The Central Bank’s decision to ease housing‑market controls surprised the market. Governor Yang said only one board member opposed the relaxation. He explained that the bank wants the market to know “the central bank is not rigid,” and that “relevant firms must also consider their sentiment,” and that the bank will continue a rolling review of market developments.

5. Sinopec Corp. (1314‑TW) Chairman Ge Shuren said the company has been gradually reducing its traditional petrochemical exposure and focusing on high‑value materials, new energy, AI‑driven high‑speed communications, and semiconductor materials as new growth engines. Sinopec is also evaluating the construction of AI data centers. The firm will cooperate with external partners to build an AI compute center; the first phase is expected to have a 5 MW capacity and a total investment of NT$2 billion.

6. Optics component maker Largan Precision (3008‑TW) continued its land‑acquisition spree after buying plots in the Taichung Industrial Zone, now purchasing industrial real estate in the Precision Machinery Park. On the 17th, Largan announced a NT$1.172 billion acquisition of land and buildings in the park from Taiwan Solid‑State Industrial. The purchase includes 2,259.25 ping of land and 3,695.25 ping of building space, intended to expand production capacity.
7. Post‑market recap: TSMC and Formosa Plastics’ “Four Treasures” all rallied, lifting the index by 439 points to retake the 46,000 level and the monthly moving average.

8. After five consecutive days of net selling, foreign investors reversed course, net buying NT$12.1 billion, heavily purchasing 53,000 shares of AU Optronics and 33,000 shares of Powerchip Semiconductor.
9. The policy rate remains frozen at the “10‑year level,” and housing‑market credit rules are loosened. Governor Yang says Taiwan will not follow the U.S. rate hikes: “We walk our own road.”
10. Inflation is slightly above the warning zone. Governor Yang notes there is still time to observe, and monetary policy remains relatively tight.
11. Discussing the housing‑market easing, Governor Yang said the central bank is not “hard‑nosed” about choking the market and is taking industry sentiment into account.
12. Ericsson partners with MediaTek to improve 5G positioning accuracy, accelerating applications in autonomous vehicles, drones, and smart manufacturing.
13. The New Taiwan dollar rises alongside equities; the “five‑day black” streak ends with a closing rate of NT$31.881 per US$.
14. Largan Precision again spends NT$1.172 billion to acquire land and factory space in Taichung’s Precision Machinery Park.
15. The Fair Trade Commission formally accepted Taiwan‑Da’s public tender offer for Jing Cheng, at a premium of 38%.
16. BlackRock’s survey shows Taiwan ETF penetration at 53% in Greater Asia‑Pacific, with next‑year allocation intent soaring to 74%.
17. Sinopec pushes its transformation into the AI market, projecting the first‑phase compute‑center investment to reach NT$2 billion.

items.title: 騰輝-KY董事會通過承租昆山廠房擴產 承接AI與HDI外溢訂單

paras: 銅箔基板大廠騰輝電子-KY(6672-TW)今(17)日召開董事會，決議向董事長王有慈承租位於中國江蘇省昆山的閒置廠房，以取得現成場地進行改建擴產，本次董事會同時通過15億元的擴廠預算，預計分三期並視未來成長需要，分別再進行二期、三期的擴增產能投資。
騰輝-KY指出，新投資案，在完善公司產品組合、顯著提升高毛利特殊材料產能，並透過縮短擴產時程，及時消化外溢訂單，為已創歷史新高的營運動能再挹注強勁成長引擎。
騰輝-KY指出，因應人工智慧（AI）及高速運算應用爆發性發展，算力硬體替代更替帶動高階PCB與基板需求擴張，各大銅箔基板（CCL）大廠優先將產能配置於高階AI伺服器，交換機與儲存等相關硬體應用，進而引發市場所有材料供需嚴重短缺、訂單外溢效應全面擴大。為迅速滿足自身強勁的市場成長需求並擴大市占率。

騰輝-KY的2026年1-8月營收已超越2025年全年，公司執行長鍾健人表示，今年營運迎來爆發性成長，2026年8月單月營收甫以8.1億元創下歷史新高，1-8月累計營收年增達43.3億元，年增53.6%。為快速回應市場的急單與外溢需求，公司選擇承租既有廠房並進行改建，相較於新建廠房可大幅縮短擴產時程，展現公司2-3周的快速交期優勢，有效掌握市場先機。本次承租廠房占地約50-55畝，空間規劃完整，未來可容納兩條自動化生產線，目標達成每月50萬張及粘合片240萬米的總產能，將全面支援第三季起預計季增3成以上的高毛利粘合片與高速材料出貨。
此外，騰輝-KY新廠鄰近既有營運據點，有利於資源整合、物流調度及管理效率提升，進一步強化營運韌性。

騰輝-KY在生產佈局與產品升級方面，現有廠房經結構調整，包括鋼構屋頂挑高及地面承重加強後，將優先安裝4台上膠設備，預計可立即增加現有粘合片產能約70%，加速投產進度。新產能配置將直接挹注公司即將於今年第四季量產的高階400V/800V AI伺服器電源材料（包括高功率散熱膜、高耐熱基板混成、高階26層以上高耐熱多層板及載板材料混成壓合板）。同時，隨著M6等級高速材料放量，以及M7、M8、M9等更高階材料持續向國際大廠進行伺服器與光模塊認證送樣，本廠房將成為高階產品量產的重要基地。
騰輝-KY 在 2026 年第二季營收 16.14 億元，毛利率 35.98%，季增 1.96 個百分點，年增 5.89 個百分點，稅後純益 2.34 億元，季增 89.24%，年增 1.64 倍，每股純益 2.96 元。
騰輝-KY2026 年上半年營收 28.59 億元，毛利率 35.13%，年增 3.11 個百分點，上半年 稅後賺 3.57 億元，年增 59.8%，每股純益達 4.75 元。
paras_en: Tenghui Electronics‑KY (6672‑TW), a major copper‑foil substrate manufacturer, held a board meeting today (the 17th) and resolved to lease an idle factory in Kunshan, Jiangsu Province, China from Chairman Wang You‑ci to obtain a ready‑made site for renovation and capacity expansion. The board also approved a NT$15 billion expansion budget, planned in three phases, with potential Phase 2 and Phase 3 capacity investments depending on future growth needs.

Tenghui‑KY said the new investment will enhance the company’s product portfolio, significantly increase high‑margin specialty material capacity, and by shortening the expansion timeline, promptly absorb overflow orders, injecting a strong growth engine into its historically record‑high operating momentum.

Tenghui‑KY noted that the explosive growth of artificial‑intelligence (AI) and high‑speed computing applications is driving a surge in demand for advanced PCBs and substrates as compute‑hardware upgrades replace older equipment. Major copper‑foil substrate (CCL) manufacturers are prioritising capacity for high‑end AI servers, switches and storage hardware, creating severe material shortages and a widespread order‑overflow effect. The company aims to quickly meet its strong market growth demand and expand market share.

Tenghui‑KY’s revenue for January‑August 2026 has already surpassed the full‑year 2025 figure. CEO Zhong Jian‑ren said the company is experiencing explosive growth this year, with August 2026 single‑month revenue reaching a historic high of NT$8.1 billion and cumulative January‑August revenue up NT$43.3 billion year‑over‑year, a 53.6% increase. To swiftly respond to urgent and overflow orders, the company chose to lease an existing plant and remodel it, which shortens the expansion timeline dramatically compared with building a new facility, showcasing a 2‑3‑week rapid delivery advantage and securing market opportunities. The leased site covers about 50‑55 mu, is fully planned, and can accommodate two automated production lines, targeting a total capacity of 500,000 sheets and 2.4 million m of adhesive films per month, fully supporting an expected >30% quarterly increase in high‑margin adhesive film and high‑speed material shipments from Q3 onward.

In addition, the new plant is adjacent to Tenghui‑KY’s existing operational sites, facilitating resource integration, logistics coordination and management efficiency, further strengthening operational resilience.

Regarding production layout and product upgrades, the existing factory will undergo structural adjustments, including raising the steel‑frame roof and strengthening floor load capacity, after which four laminating machines will be installed first, expected to boost current adhesive‑film capacity by about 70% and accelerate commissioning. The new capacity will directly feed the high‑end 400 V/800 V AI server power‑supply materials slated for mass production in Q4 this year (including high‑power thermal‑film, high‑temperature hybrid substrates, advanced 26‑layer‑plus high‑temperature multilayer boards and hybrid laminate carrier boards). At the same time, as M6‑grade high‑speed materials scale up and higher‑grade M7, M8, M9 materials continue to be submitted for server and optical‑module certification to international OEMs, the plant will become a key base for high‑end product mass production.

Tenghui‑KY reported Q2 2026 revenue of NT$1.614 billion, gross margin of 35.98% (up 1.96 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter and 5.89 points year‑over‑year), after‑tax net profit of NT$234 million (up 89.24% quarter‑over‑quarter and 1.64‑fold year‑over‑year), and earnings per share of NT$2.96.

For the first half of 2026, Tenghui‑KY posted revenue of NT$2.859 billion, gross margin of 35.13% (up 3.11 percentage points year‑over‑year), after‑tax profit of NT$357 million (up 59.8% year‑over‑year), and earnings per share of NT$4.75.

items.title: 〈房產〉金仲獎揭曉 信義企業集團20人獲獎再奪業界之冠
items.title_en: <Real Estate> Golden Agent Awards Announced: Xinyi Enterprise Group Wins Again with 20 Awardees, Reclaiming Industry Crown
paras: 年度度房仲業盛事的第25屆傑出「金仲獎」楷模頒獎典禮今(17)日登場，信義(9940-TW)企業集團共20人獲獎，再度拿下業界第一，其中3人獲頒象徵第一的「評審團大獎」，鳳山文山店經理吳琪慧更同時囊括最佳形象獎。
本屆金仲獎由不動產仲介經紀商業同業公會全國聯合會舉辦，信義企業集團共20人獲獎再創業界第一，經紀人組與營業員組分別有10位獲得「房仲楷模」；另外「評審團大獎」部分，共有11位同仁入圍、3名獲獎，大獎得主之一的鳳山文山店經理吳琪慧更二度獲獎，再度拿下最佳形象獎，「先義後利」、「以人為本」的企業精神再受肯定。

今年的評審團大獎得主、同時囊括最佳形象獎的信義房屋鳳山文山店經理吳琪慧是雲林子弟，離鄉背井到高雄加入信義房屋轉眼已11年，初到高雄租屋碰過半夜積水自天花板傾瀉而下的孤立無助，讓她懂得替別人撐傘，也更了解客戶對「家」的渴望、在意每一位客戶真正的需求。曾經陪伴看了10年房子的單親爸爸一路找房，協助他分析風險釐清需求，成交後客戶一句「「謝謝妳，讓我終於完成人生大事，心裡輕鬆很多」，讓吳琪慧更肯定房仲的價值是讓人在重要決定裡感到安心。

同樣獲得評審團大獎的信義房屋竹北文興店專案經理范財嘉，過去當過科技公司的業務，轉戰房仲的新人時期曾面臨名片被管理員當面丟掉的窘境，但他沒有退縮，依舊以真誠與熱忱深耕社區，不僅化解對方敵意，更獲取信任主動轉介客戶。秉持「先義後利」的精神，范財嘉始終為客戶多想一步，曾有外國籍客戶因缺乏本國身分在購屋貸款上屢屢碰壁，他主動陪著客戶奔走、反覆與銀行協商，最終找到願意核貸的銀行、順利成交。後續不僅受邀參加新居入厝，更與客戶成為好友並推薦許多客戶。這一路讓范財嘉堅信，房仲工作的價值不只是促成交易，更是透過專業建立信任，成為人與社會連結的重要力量。
另外一位獲得評審團大獎的信義房屋新埔新站店專案經理王煒智，大學就讀工業工程管理，初入行花了10個月才順利轉正，是全區最晚轉正的新人，但這段經歷讓王煒智奠定「成功或許可以很快，但真正長久的成長，來自於跌倒後仍願意繼續前進」的信念，一路突破成為績優專案經理。他不僅樂於與同仁分享經驗，熱心參與社區活動，面對客戶總是細心的觀察客戶性格與需求調整溝通方式，專業與細緻的服務深獲客戶讚賞。
金仲獎每年由各縣市不動產仲介經紀商業同業公會推薦優秀人員進行遴選，今年於大直典華頒發獎項，除了全台各地的房仲楷模外，另外也會從所有入選者中評選出象徵全國第一的「評審團大獎」，並於現場揭曉得獎者，不同組別各選出五位；並且從評審團大獎得獎者中再遴選出最佳形象、最佳人氣與最佳台風等三位得主。

信義房屋20位獲得房仲楷模的夥伴來自北中南各地，分別為中山晴光專案經理陳冠佑、中山南京專案經理張國榮、新埔新站專案經理王煒智、安康安德專員吳勝哲、土城清水專案經理顏究真、平鎮專員張鈞鋐、小檜溪重劃專員韓鎔安、黎明向上專員劉鎮城、永康鹽行執行經理陳萱蓉、鳳山文山經理吳琪慧、三重雙捷專案經理陳茲芃、汐止樟樹主任黃晨媛、古亭專案經理劉宇軒、內壢經理范姜世旻、竹科專案經理邱竹儀、竹北文興專案經理范財嘉、七期河南專案經理周冠泓、永康鹽行專案經理李子揚、文化店經理詹懿以及信義全球專案暨標售部專案經理李祥楡。
信義房屋指出，公司秉持「先義後利」、「以人為本」的企業理念，並且由上而下深植於員工的心中，更體現在他們的日常工作中。未來將致力提供更值得信賴、更貼心且全面的服務，讓每一名消費者都能感受到信義人的真誠與關懷，實現「有信義的地方，就有幸福」的美好願景。
paras_en: The 25th annual Golden Agent Awards ceremony, the premier event of the year for the real‑estate brokerage industry, was held today (the 17th). Xinyi Enterprise Group (9940‑TW) saw 20 of its staff win awards, once again taking the top spot in the industry. Among them, three received the top‑honor “Jury Grand Prize,” and store manager Wu Qihui of the Fengshan Wenshan branch also captured the Best Image Award.

The awards this year were organized by the National Federation of Real‑Estate Brokerage Trade Associations. Xinyi Enterprise Group’s 20 winners set a new industry record, with ten agents and ten sales staff each earning the “Real‑Estate Model” title. For the Jury Grand Prize, 11 colleagues were shortlisted and three were selected; one of the winners was Wu Qihui, manager of the Fengshan Wenshan store, who also won the Best Image Award for a second time, reaffirming the company’s “principle before profit” and “people‑first” spirit.

Wu Qihui, the Fengshan Wenshan store manager who won both the Jury Grand Prize and the Best Image Award, hails from Yunlin. She left her hometown to join Xinyi in Kaohsiung eleven years ago. Her first experience renting in Kaohsiung involved a midnight ceiling leak that left her feeling isolated and helpless, teaching her to “hold an umbrella for others” and deepening her empathy for clients’ yearning for a home. She once helped a single‑father who had been searching for a home for ten years, clarifying his needs and risks; after the deal closed, he said, “Thank you, you finally helped me complete this major life event; I feel much lighter,” reinforcing Wu’s belief in the value of real‑estate agents in providing peace of mind during critical decisions.

Another Jury Grand Prize winner, project manager Fan Caijia of Xinyi’s Zhubei Wenxing store, previously worked in sales for a tech company. When he first entered real‑estate, a building manager threw his business cards away, but he persisted with sincerity and enthusiasm, turning hostility into trust and referrals. Living by the “principle before profit” ethos, Fan always thinks one step ahead for clients. He assisted a foreign client who repeatedly hit loan obstacles due to lack of local status, accompanying the client to negotiate with banks until a lender approved the loan and the deal closed. The client later invited him to a house‑warming and became a friend who referred many others, confirming Fan’s view that the agent’s role is not just to close deals but to build trust and connect people to society.

The third Jury Grand Prize recipient, project manager Wang Weizhi of Xinyi’s Xinpu Xinzhan store, studied industrial engineering management in college. He took ten months to become a regular employee—the longest in the region—but that experience forged his belief that “quick success is possible, but lasting growth comes from persisting after a fall.” He has since risen to top‑performing project manager, sharing knowledge with colleagues, actively participating in community events, and carefully tailoring communication to each client’s personality and needs, earning high praise for his professional and meticulous service.

The Golden Agent Awards are held annually, with nominations submitted by local real‑estate brokerage trade associations. This year’s ceremony took place at the Dazhi Dianhua venue. In addition to the nationwide “Real‑Estate Model” honorees, a “Jury Grand Prize” representing the top of the field is selected from all nominees, with five winners per category announced on‑stage. From the Grand Prize winners, three further awards—Best Image, Most Popular, and Best Stage Presence—are chosen.

The 20 Xinyi agents honored as Real‑Estate Models come from across the north, central and south regions: project manager Chen Guanyou (Zhongshan Qingguang), project manager Zhang Guorong (Zhongshan Nanjing), project manager Wang Weizhi (Xinpu Xinzhan), specialist Wu Shengzhe (Ankang Ander), project manager Yan Jiuzhen (Tucheng Qingshui), specialist Zhang Junhong (Pingzhen), redevelopment specialist Han Rong’an (Xiaohui Creek), specialist Liu Zhencheng (Liming Xiangshang), executive manager Chen Xuanrong (Yongkang Yanhang), manager Wu Qihui (Fengshan Wenshan), project manager Chen Zipeng (Sanchong Shuangjie), director Huang Chenyuan (Xizhi Zhangshu), project manager Liu Yuxuan (Gutting), manager Fan Jiang Shimin (Neili), project manager Qiu Zhuyi (Hsinchu Science Park), project manager Fan Caijia (Zhubei Wenxing), project manager Zhou Guanhong (Qiqi Hexian), project manager Li Ziyang (Yongkang Yanhang), manager Zhan Yi (Cultural Store), and project manager Li Xiangyu (Xinyi Global Project & Auction Department).

Xinyi Real Estate emphasizes its corporate philosophy of “principle before profit” and “people‑first,” which is deeply ingrained from top management down to every employee and reflected in daily work. Going forward, the company aims to provide more trustworthy, caring and comprehensive services so that every consumer experiences the sincerity and concern of Xinyi staff, fulfilling the vision that “where there is Xinyi, there is happiness.”

items.title: 〈房產〉金仲獎至高榮譽 台灣房屋總裁彭培業獲頒「終身奉獻獎」
items.title_en: <Real Estate> Golden Broker Award Highest Honor: Taiwan Housing President Peng Pei-ye Receives Lifetime Contribution Award
paras: 年度度房仲業盛事的第25屆傑出「金仲獎」楷模頒獎典禮今(17)日登場，本屆「終身奉獻獎」首度由房仲品牌領導人獲獎，台灣房屋集團總裁彭培業榮獲此項殊榮，為房仲業寫下至高榮耀的新紀錄。
不動產仲介經紀商業同業公會全國聯合會理事長王瑞祺表示，「終身奉獻獎」為不動產仲介經紀業至高殿堂榮譽，主要在表彰長期深耕產業、功勳卓著、深孚眾望，對產業制度奠基、專業精進、人才培育及永續發展具有重大貢獻與深遠影響之卓越領袖。
彭培業長年秉持誠信、專業、服務之核心信念，奉獻不動產仲介經紀產業，從產業經營、人才培育、社會責任到公益實踐，各面向成就斐然、建樹卓著，深獲產官學界高度肯定，堪為產業推動永續發展的卓越典範。
彭培業總裁深耕房地產業逾40年，秉持「服務以人為本、管理以人為主」的核心理念，突破房仲買屋、賣屋的傳統框架，從打造房仲智慧服務，到因應高齡化社會投入健康地產，不僅開發亞洲健康智慧園區，更榮登國際級的品質，充分實現社會企業責任的理念，這些都是從消費者需求與社會趨勢，尋找出房仲業的新趨勢，讓「家」的意義從一間房子，延伸到居住環境、健康生活與跨世代的幸福。
彭培業將房仲專業擴大至環境、健康與社會議題，重新定義房仲企業可以創造的價值，就是想為員工、消費者、環境與社會多做些什麼。面對氣候暖化全球議題，他率先啟動植樹造林計畫，於全台四大林場栽植養護超過3萬5000棵樹木，許多人會問，賣房子的人，為什麼選擇種森林，彭培業認為，不只是做別人不做的事，而是想做對的事，
彭培業指出，環境永續是企業肩負的社會責任，不能只是少數人的理念，而要成為一家公司、全民的共同信念，從一棵樹開始，讓每一個人都參與其中，才能共創共好。彭培業同時推動健康農場、友善食安，守護員工與家人的健康生活。而6000坪養生宅「亞洲健康智慧園區」，更為台灣樂齡住宅開闢新典範，為房仲業服務重新定位，開創新紀元。
彭培業以「一家人」為經營哲學，視同仁如親，因此公司裡沒有所謂的總裁，而是以「二哥」來稱呼，他將員工、加盟主視為共同成長的家人，重視人才培育、創造工作價值，帶領品牌多次榮獲幸福企業大獎肯定！在他的經營理念下，企業不只是工作的場所，更是彼此信任、共同成長的家。
paras_en: The 25th Annual Outstanding "Golden Broker Award" ceremony, the premier event of the year for the real‑estate brokerage industry, took place today (the 17th). This year’s Lifetime Contribution Award was awarded for the first time to a leader of a brokerage brand, with Peng Pei-ye, President of Taiwan Housing Group, receiving the honor and setting a new record of supreme glory for the industry.

Wang Rui‑chi, Chairman of the National Federation of Real‑Estate Brokerage Associations, said the Lifetime Contribution Award represents the highest honor in the brokerage field, recognizing leaders who have long cultivated the industry, achieved outstanding merit, earned widespread respect, and made major contributions to institutional foundations, professional advancement, talent development and sustainable growth.

Peng Pei‑ye has long upheld the core values of integrity, professionalism and service, dedicating himself to the real‑estate brokerage sector. His achievements span business operations, talent cultivation, social responsibility and public‑welfare initiatives, earning high praise from government, academia and industry and serving as an exemplary model for sustainable industry development.

With more than 40 years in real‑estate, President Peng adheres to the philosophy “service centered on people, management led by people.” He has broken the traditional buying‑and‑selling framework, advancing smart brokerage services and, in response to an aging society, investing in health‑focused real‑estate. He has developed an Asian health‑smart park that meets international quality standards, fully embodying corporate social responsibility. By listening to consumer needs and social trends, he identifies new directions for the brokerage sector, expanding the meaning of “home” from a mere dwelling to a living environment, healthy lifestyle and inter‑generational happiness.

Peng has broadened brokerage expertise to include environmental, health and social issues, redefining the value a brokerage can create for employees, consumers, the environment and society. Confronting global climate change, he launched a tree‑planting program, planting and caring for over 35,000 trees across four major forest farms in Taiwan. When asked why a real‑estate seller would plant forests, Peng answered that it is not just about doing what others don’t, but about doing what is right.

Peng emphasized that environmental sustainability is a corporate social responsibility that must become a shared belief of the whole company and society, not just a minority view. Starting with a single tree and involving everyone is the way to achieve collective benefit. He also promotes healthy farms and food safety, protecting the health of employees and their families. The 6,000‑ping (approximately 19,800 sqm) wellness residence, the “Asian Health‑Smart Park,” sets a new benchmark for senior living in Taiwan, redefining brokerage services and ushering in a new era.

Peng runs the company with a “one‑family” philosophy, treating colleagues as relatives. Consequently, there is no formal title of president within the firm; he is affectionately called “Second Brother.” He regards employees and franchisees as family members growing together, prioritizes talent development and meaningful work, and has led the brand to win multiple Happiness Enterprise Awards. Under his leadership, the company is more than a workplace—it is a trusted home for mutual growth.

items.title: Fed重啟升息台股承壓？野村拆解26年數據：1年回歸基本面 慎防3大修正警訊
items.title_en: Fed Resumes Rate Hikes, Taiwan Stocks Under Pressure? Nomura Breaks Down 26 Years of Data: One-Year Return to Fundamentals, Guard Against Three Major Correction Signals
paras: 聯準會（Fed）於台灣時間今（17）日凌晨宣布升息1碼，主席華許指出美經濟走強且通膨仍高，美股聞聲下挫。對此，野村投信統計2000年以來三次降息循環後首次升息經驗，台股短線易受利率與評價調整干擾，升息後1個月平均下跌3.99%，但1年、2年與3年平均報酬分別達3.57%、19.73%與33.74%，最遲一年即可回歸基本面。本輪貨幣政策與2004年相似，皆在降息結束約1年後升息，且同處科技提升生產力階段，當年由網路驅動，如今則由AI接棒，中長期行情仍值得期待，但需觀察三個指標。
主動野村台灣高息ETF（00999A）基金經理人游景德表示，台股短線受美債殖利率與外資流向牽動，指數恐偏震盪。AI龍頭相對具支撐，高估值中小型股、融資股及高負債公司壓力較大。未來1至6個月，企業獲利將取代本益比擴張，只要AI供應鏈營收、毛利率及獲利預估持續上修，即可消化部分高利率壓力。本次升息源於強勁需求與資本支出，並非經濟衰退，資金將由「有題材」轉向真正具備現金流、訂單與議價能力的企業。
在產業配置上，潛在贏家包括AI基礎建設龍頭、美元營收出口商、現金充裕低負債公司及部分金融股。銀行股受惠利差與海外收益改善，壽險股則須留意長債評價與避險成本。至於可能輸家，包含高估值未獲利中小型科技股、營建與租賃等高負債公司、仰賴融資的新創、生技與再生能源，以及面臨成本壓力的航空、下游石化與低成長高股息族群。
展望後市，游景德提出3大觀察指標：第一，美國10年期公債殖利率5%為評價分水嶺，若升破5.25%，台股估值壓力將明顯加重；第二，布蘭特原油若站穩每桶110美元以上，升息預期恐再升溫；第三，觀察外資與台積電 (2330-TW) 等AI權值股表現，若外資賣超但AI龍頭守穩，偏向結構調整，若兩者同步轉弱，指數修正風險才會升高。投資策略宜降低槓桿、保留彈性，布局具獲利能見度與現金流支撐的企業。
paras_en: The Federal Reserve announced a 0.25‑point rate hike in the early hours of today (Sept 17 Taiwan time). Chair Jerome Powell noted that the U.S. economy remains strong while inflation stays high, prompting a pull‑back in U.S. equities. Nomura Asset Management examined the three post‑2000 rate‑cut cycles and found that the first hike after a tightening cycle tends to weigh on Taiwan’s market in the short term – the index fell an average of 3.99% in the month after a hike – but over one, two and three years the average returns were 3.57%, 19.73% and 33.74% respectively, meaning fundamentals tend to re‑assert themselves within a year. This round of policy is similar to 2004, when hikes began about a year after the end of easing, and both periods coincide with a productivity‑boosting tech era – then driven by the internet, now by AI – so the medium‑ to long‑term outlook remains positive, though three warning indicators should be watched.

Fund manager You Jing‑de of Nomura’s Taiwan High‑Yield ETF (00999A) said Taiwan’s market is currently being tugged by U.S. Treasury yields and foreign‑investor flows, likely leading to a choppy index. AI‑lead stocks have relative support, while high‑valuation small‑caps, leveraged stocks and highly indebted firms face greater pressure. Over the next one to six months, corporate earnings will replace P/E expansion as the key driver; as long as AI‑chain revenue, margins and profit forecasts keep being upgraded, they can absorb part of the high‑rate stress. This hike stems from strong demand and capex, not a recession, so capital will shift from “thematic” bets to companies with real cash flow, order books and pricing power.

In terms of sector allocation, potential winners include AI‑infrastructure leaders, exporters with dollar‑denominated revenue, cash‑rich low‑debt firms and some financial stocks. Banks should benefit from wider spreads and better overseas earnings, while life‑insurance stocks need to watch long‑bond valuations and hedging costs. Likely losers are over‑valued, unprofitable small‑cap tech names, high‑debt construction and leasing firms, financing‑dependent startups, biotech and renewable‑energy companies, as well as airlines, downstream petrochemicals and low‑growth high‑dividend groups that face cost pressures.

Looking ahead, You Jing‑de highlighted three observation points: first, the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield at 5% is a valuation threshold – a rise above 5.25% would noticeably increase valuation pressure on Taiwan stocks; second, Brent crude holding above US$110 per barrel could reignite rate‑hike expectations; third, watch foreign‑investor activity and the performance of AI‑weight stocks such as TSMC (2330‑TW). If foreigners sell but AI leaders hold steady, it suggests a structural adjustment; if both weaken together, the risk of an index correction rises. Investment strategy should reduce leverage, retain flexibility, and focus on companies with clear profit visibility and solid cash‑flow support.

items.title: 新增5檔股票明起抓去關  飆股全友、聯一光處置期至9/30
items.title_en: Five Stocks Added to Trading Halt Starting Tomorrow; Hot Stocks Quanyou and Lianyi Guang to Remain Restricted Until Sept. 30

近年從掃描器大廠轉型，並積極拓展光電子設備的全友處置原因：最近6個營業日累積收盤價漲幅達45.96%；最近30個營業日起迄2個營業日之收盤價漲幅達104.9%；最近90個營業日起迄2個營業日之收盤價漲幅達223.21%。
