items.title: 殖利率壓不下來 美債這鍋「毒湯」裡到底煮了什麼？
items.title_en: Yield Can't Be Driven Down: What Exactly Is Brewing in the 'Toxic Soup' of U.S. Treasuries?
paras: 美國公債市場是全球規模最大的債券市場之一，每日交易量高達 1.2 兆美元。由於規模龐大，美債市場也成為美國經濟的強力鏡像，反映來自各方的風險，包括通膨、戰爭、財政赤字以及人口結構危機。
近期，美國部分最受關注的公債殖利率明顯攀升，顯示市場對這些風險的擔憂正在升溫。
30 年期美債殖利率近期升至 20 年來高點，10 年期美債殖利率則攀升超過 0.5 個百分點。10 年期美債是房貸、汽車貸款以及部分商業信貸的重要基準，其走勢受到市場高度關注。
殖利率持續攀升令美國財長貝森特（Scott Bessent）感到不安。他已投入數十億美元推動債券回購，希望壓低利率，但這項措施遭到不少經濟學家與金融業人士批評，且截至目前並未真正奏效。
AI熱潮支撐經濟 債市仍面臨多重壓力
美國經濟目前的基本面仍相對強勁，失業率維持歷史低檔，市場對經濟衰退的擔憂也因人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮帶動的大規模支出而減弱。
但究竟是什麼因素正在擾動債券市場？耶魯大學預算實驗室（Budget Lab at Yale University）執行主任金博爾（Martha Gimbel）表示，市場憂慮來自多項因素交織，「它們彼此纏繞，形成一鍋有毒的混合物」。
其中一項主要因素就是美國聯邦債務。截至 8 月中旬，美國聯邦債務正式突破 40 兆美元。對於關注財政紀律的「財政鷹派」而言，最令人擔憂的是，過去 20 年美國債務增長速度已超越經濟成長。
自 2006 年以來，美國聯邦總債務增加近 5 倍，但國內生產毛額（GDP）增幅不到 2.5 倍。
資產管理公司阿波羅全球管理首席經濟學家斯洛克（Torsten Slok）在電子報中指出，「債務累積速度超過支撐償還債務的經濟成長速度」，美國債務占 GDP 比率已從當時不到 40%，升至目前約 100%。
赤字擴大成兩黨問題 財政路線引發市場疑慮
美國財政問題的根源部分來自華府政治人物，包括兩黨都難辭其咎。長期以來，政治人物逐漸接受規模愈來愈大的預算赤字。
喬治華盛頓大學（George Washington University）經濟系主任辛克萊（Tara Sinclair）表示，她可以接受經濟低迷或危機時期出現赤字，「但我們不能永遠一再堆疊債務」。
美國總統川普則認為，美國可以透過經濟成長解決債務問題。他在 8 月表示：「解決債務的方法就是成長，而我們正擁有非常強勁的成長。我們從未有過像現在這樣的成長。」
不過，多數經濟學家認為，政治人物不應提出過於簡化的解決方案，因為美國最終仍可能需要面對債務問題帶來的成本。
其中一種方式是大量印鈔，用資金償還債務，但其副作用可能十分嚴重，包括美元貶值以及通膨升溫，也可能削弱投資人信心。畢竟，投資人不會願意購買一個國家的 10 年期公債，而該國貨幣價值可能因物價失控而大幅下降。
另一種方式則是削減支出，以縮小財政赤字，但這可能涉及削減社會安全、醫療保險等福利計畫以及其他政府服務。
英國與希臘的經驗顯示，大規模緊縮政策可能嚴重影響民眾生活品質、拖累經濟成長，並削弱政府運作能力，也可能導致執政黨承受政治壓力。
美債難安的關鍵變數：聯準會下一步怎麼走
金博爾表示，全球市場近期高度關注華許的動向，也凸顯聯準會在整體市場中的重要性。華許的一言一行，甚至沉默不語，都可能影響美國債券市場，而美債市場又牽動全球債市。
她指出，如果市場認為聯準會未來不像過去那樣可靠，或政策效果可能減弱，投資人就必須將這項風險反映在債券價格中。
不過，影響市場的不只是政府支出增加與央行政策。
長期以來，美國公債被視為全球各類債務中信用品質最高的資產，即使面對貿易戰、債務上限爭議以及政治角力，市場仍普遍認為，美國擁有貨幣發行能力，幾乎不可能違約。
金博爾表示：「目前還沒有其他地方能提供同等程度的安全性與便利性。難道你要把資金放到法國嗎？」
科技巨頭崛起 美債面臨新的安全資產競爭
然而，如今美國公債正面臨不同以往的競爭者。
根據彭博計算，過去 5 年，美國資料中心投資規模最大的 5 家企業：Alphabe(GOOGL-US) 、亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、Meta(META-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 與甲骨文(ORCL-US) ，合計增加約 4120 億美元債務。
其中數家公司擁有媲美國家的資產負債表，以及極高的信用評等。這意味著投資人如今有更多選擇，可以將資金配置在高安全性的資產，因此美國政府可能必須提供更高報酬率，才能與其他債券發行人競爭。
美債殖利率走向仍存變數
未來，美國公債殖利率是否會在高檔維持更長時間，進一步推升政府借貸成本、房貸以及其他信貸成本，或者在沃許政策立場偏向鷹派，或 AI 能夠證明足以帶動經濟成長、協助改善債務問題後回落，仍難以判斷。
不過，辛克萊並不擔心全球投資人會突然失去對美債的需求。她表示，美國在全球貿易與金融體系中的核心地位，意味著全世界都希望美國避免出現重大金融危機，「所有人都會試圖阻止這種情況發生」。
換句話說，美國債券市場如今規模龐大，對全球經濟的重要性極高，已經達到「大到不能倒」的程度。
paras_en: The U.S. Treasury market is one of the world’s largest bond markets, with daily trading volume reaching $1.2 trillion. Because of its sheer size, the market serves as a powerful mirror of the U.S. economy, reflecting risks from inflation, wars, fiscal deficits and demographic challenges.
Recently, yields on several of the most closely watched U.S. government bonds have risen sharply, indicating growing market anxiety about these risks.

The 30‑year Treasury yield has climbed to a 20‑year high, while the 10‑year yield has jumped more than 0.5 percentage points. The 10‑year note is a key benchmark for mortgages, auto loans and many commercial credit products, so its movement draws intense market attention.

The rising yields have unsettled Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent. He has deployed tens of billions of dollars in bond buybacks to try to push rates lower, but the move has drawn criticism from many economists and finance professionals and, so far, has not produced the desired effect.
AI hype supports the economy, but the bond market still faces multiple pressures
U.S. economic fundamentals remain relatively strong, with unemployment at historic lows, and concerns about a recession have eased as AI‑driven investment sprees have spurred large‑scale spending.

But what exactly is unsettling the bond market? Martha Gimbel, director of the Budget Lab at Yale University, says the worries stem from a mix of intertwined factors that “tangle together into a toxic brew.”

One major factor is the federal debt. By mid‑August, the U.S. federal debt officially breached $40 trillion. For fiscally‑conservative “hawkish” observers, the biggest worry is that debt growth over the past two decades has outpaced economic growth.
Since 2006, total federal debt has risen almost five‑fold, while GDP has grown less than 2.5‑fold.

Torsten Slok, chief economist at Apollo Global Management, noted in a newsletter that “the debt is accumulating faster than the economy can grow to service it,” with the debt‑to‑GDP ratio climbing from under 40% back then to roughly 100% today.
Deficits widening become a bipartisan issue, raising market doubts about fiscal direction
The root of America’s fiscal problem lies partly with Washington politicians, and both parties share responsibility. Over time, lawmakers have become accustomed to ever‑larger budget deficits.
Tara Sinclair, chair of the economics department at George Washington University, says she can accept deficits during downturns or crises, “but we cannot keep piling up debt forever.”

Former President Donald Trump argues the U.S. can solve its debt problem through growth. In August he said, “The solution to debt is growth, and we have very strong growth. We’ve never had growth like this.”
Most economists, however, warn that politicians should not offer overly simplistic fixes, because the U.S. will eventually have to face the costs of its debt burden.

One option is massive money printing to pay down debt, but its side effects could be severe, including a weaker dollar, higher inflation and eroded investor confidence. After all, investors won’t buy a country’s 10‑year bonds if its currency is expected to lose value dramatically due to runaway prices.
Another approach is cutting spending to shrink the fiscal deficit, which could involve reductions to Social Security, Medicare and other welfare programs as well as various government services.

The experiences of the U.K. and Greece show that large‑scale austerity can severely affect living standards, drag on growth and weaken governmental capacity, potentially exposing the ruling party to political pressure.
Key variable for shaky Treasuries: what the Fed does next

Gimbel says global markets are closely watching the Fed’s moves, underscoring the central bank’s importance to the overall market. Every word—or even silence—from the Fed can sway the U.S. bond market, which in turn influences global debt markets.
She notes that if investors begin to doubt the Fed’s future reliability or the effectiveness of its policies, they will have to price that risk into bond yields.
However, it’s not only higher government spending and central‑bank policy that affect the market.

For decades, U.S. Treasuries have been viewed as the highest‑quality credit among global debt instruments. Even amid trade wars, debt‑ceiling battles and political fights, markets generally believe the U.S. can issue currency at will and is virtually incapable of defaulting.
Gimbel adds, “There’s currently no other place that can offer the same level of safety and convenience. Are you really going to put your money in France?”
Tech giants rise, creating new competition for Treasuries as safe assets
Now, U.S. Treasuries face competition unlike before.

Bloomberg estimates that over the past five years the five biggest U.S. data‑center investors—Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US), Meta (META‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and Oracle (ORCL‑US)—have collectively added about $412 billion of debt.

Some of these firms have balance sheets comparable to sovereigns and enjoy very high credit ratings, meaning investors now have more high‑quality options and the U.S. government may need to offer higher yields to compete with other issuers.
Treasury yield trajectory still uncertain

Going forward, it remains unclear whether Treasury yields will stay elevated for an extended period—pushing up government borrowing costs, mortgage rates and other credit costs—or whether a more hawkish Fed stance or AI‑driven growth that helps solve the debt issue will cause yields to retreat.

Sinclair, however, is not worried that global investors will suddenly abandon Treasuries. She points out that America’s central role in global trade and finance means the world wants the U.S. to avoid a major financial crisis, “everyone will try to prevent that from happening.”
In other words, the U.S. bond market is now so massive and vital to the global economy that it has become “too big to fail.”

items.title: 10年期美債殖利率回落至4.93% 分析師：最劇烈賣壓已過
items.title_en: 10-year US Treasury Yield Falls to 4.93% – Analysts Say the Sharpest Selling Pressure Is Over
paras: 《CNBC》報導，聯準會 (Fed) 啟動逾3年來首次升息後，美債殖利率週四 (17 日) 全線回落，分析師認為，美債市場此輪最劇烈的價格調整可能已經過去，當前較高的殖利率水準為投資人提供鎖定收益的機會。
10年期美債殖利率下跌逾7個基點至4.93%，30年期殖利率下跌逾6個基點至5.282%；對貨幣政策較敏感的2年期殖利率也下滑逾5個基點至4.67%。債券價格與殖利率走勢相反。
Fed週三以12比0一致決議升息1碼，將聯邦資金利率目標區間上調至3.75%至4%，為2023年7月以來首次升息。由於近期通膨數據持續偏高，加上債市承壓，市場事前已普遍預期Fed將採取行動。
Fed主席華許在會後記者會上表示，通膨過高的情況已持續太久。Fed必須確信基礎通膨正明確且以足夠快的速度回到政策目標，但聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 認為目前尚未達到這項標準。
最新利率點狀圖顯示，18名決策官員中有16人預期今年還會升息。其中，12人預期再升息1碼，另有4人認為可能再升息2碼。
Edwards Asset Management投資長Bob Edwards表示，債市此輪最大幅度的波動可能已經過去。經歷近期價格調整後，投資人目前有機會鎖定較高殖利率。
他預期，Fed若今年再次升息，時間可能落在12月。由於10月會議距離美國期中選舉僅數日，Fed可能避免在該次會議調整利率，以免外界認為政策決定具有政治考量。
市場同時關注華許與川普之間的互動。川普持續要求Fed降息，主張美國利率應降至1%或更低，並批評Fed理事會「非常敵對、非常政治化」，正在採取錯誤行動。
經濟數據方面，截至9月12日當週，美國初領失業救濟金人數為19.6萬人，低於道瓊調查經濟學家預估的20.7萬人，顯示勞動市場仍具韌性；8月新屋開工數則低於市場預期。
paras_en: CNBC reported that after the Federal Reserve’s first rate hike in more than three years, US Treasury yields fell across the board on Thursday (the 17th). Analysts believe the most intense price adjustment in the Treasury market may be behind us, and the current relatively high yield levels offer investors an opportunity to lock in returns.

The 10-year Treasury yield dropped more than 7 basis points to 4.93%, while the 30-year yield fell over 6 basis points to 5.282%. The 2-year yield, which is more sensitive to monetary policy, also slipped more than 5 basis points to 4.67%. Bond prices move inversely to yields.

The Fed voted unanimously 12‑0 on Wednesday to raise rates by one quarter point, moving the federal funds target range to 3.75%‑4%, its first hike since July 2023. With recent inflation data remaining elevated and bond markets under pressure, markets had broadly expected the Fed to act.

Fed Chair Jerome Powell said in the post‑meeting press conference that inflation has been too high for too long. The Fed must be confident that core inflation is clearly moving back toward the policy target at a sufficiently rapid pace, but the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) believes that standard has not yet been met.

The latest rate dot‑plot shows that out of 18 policymakers, 16 expect at least one more hike this year. Twelve anticipate another 25‑basis‑point increase, while four think a 50‑basis‑point hike is possible.

Bob Edwards, Chief Investment Officer at Edwards Asset Management, said the biggest wave of volatility in the bond market may have passed. After the recent price adjustment, investors now have a chance to lock in higher yields.

He expects that if the Fed raises rates again this year, it will likely happen in December. Because the October meeting falls just days before the U.S. midterm elections, the Fed may avoid adjusting rates at that meeting to prevent the perception that the decision is politically motivated.

Markets are also watching the interaction between Powell and former President Trump. Trump continues to urge the Fed to cut rates, arguing that U.S. rates should fall to 1% or lower, and he has criticized the Fed Board as “very hostile, very politicized,” saying it is taking the wrong actions.

On the economic data side, for the week ending September 12, initial unemployment claims in the United States were 196,000, below the Dow Jones economists’ forecast of 207,000, indicating continued labor‑market resilience; meanwhile, August new‑home starts came in below market expectations.

items.title: SpaceX大漲5%後續走高 AI需求並未放緩
items.title_en: SpaceX jumps 5% and continues higher as AI demand remains strong
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，AI需求就是沒有放緩，而SpaceX(SPCX-US)股價周四(17日)再度上漲。
馬斯克(Elon Musk)旗下這家火箭與AI公司股價周四上漲2.6%，至154.81美元。同期標普500指數與道瓊工業平均指數分別上漲1.1%與0.6%。
SpaceX周三已大漲5.2%。公司安排旗下大型可完全重複使用火箭Starship進行第14次試飛，這項消息可能也對股價有所提振。最初預定的發射日期為9月22日，根據公司網站，目前已改定於9月28日進行。
有關SK海力士(SK Hynix)正與英特爾(INTC-US)洽談在美國生產記憶體晶片的報導，也可能推升SpaceX股價。
花旗分析師Atif Malik周三寫道，「這些討論可能代表英特爾擴大與SpaceX合作關係的又一步。」
他表示，「SK海力士/英特爾可能提供位於美國的記憶體製造能力，與英特爾14A製程及先進封裝業務形成互補。」
SpaceX正與特斯拉(TSLA-US)在德州奧斯汀共同興建晶片製造設施，因公司認為，半導體供應最終可能成為AI成長的瓶頸。
SpaceX的成長表現已多次超出市場預期。市場預估SpaceX 2027年的AI營收將達約670億美元，而6月時的預估僅為380億美元。
此外，華爾街目前預期SpaceX 2030年的AI營收將達約2,750億美元，6月時的預估則約為1,100億美元。
根據花旗美國投資級信用策略主管Daniel Sorid，截至第二季末，大型雲端服務商的積壓訂單約達2.5兆美元，可作為AI需求的代理指標，年增約100%，相比2022年底ChatGPT推出前不到5,000億美元的水準大幅增加。
第二季雲端營收首次突破1,000億美元。資料中心資本支出也首次超過1,000億美元。
當然，持續成長的AI需求對SpaceX而言是利多。SpaceX第二季末擁有1.4GW的AI運算能力。(運算能力通常以維持運作所需的電力來衡量。)SpaceX希望到2027年底，AI算力最高可達10GW。
要準確判斷究竟是什麼因素正推動SpaceX股價並不容易。自6月IPO以來，該股一直相當波動，上市初期最高曾達225.64美元，最低則跌至104.83美元。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that AI demand has not slowed, and SpaceX (SPCX-US) stock rose again on Thursday the 17th.
Elon Musk’s rocket and AI company saw its shares climb 2.6% on Thursday to $154.81, while the S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 1.1% and 0.6% respectively.

SpaceX had already surged 5.2% on Wednesday. The company scheduled its large fully reusable Starship rocket for its 14th test flight, a development that may have buoyed the stock. The launch was originally set for Sept. 22 but, according to the company website, has been moved to Sept. 28.
Reports that SK Hynix is in talks with Intel (INTC-US) about producing memory chips in the United States may also be lifting SpaceX’s share price.
Citi analyst Atif Malik wrote on Wednesday that “these discussions could represent another step in Intel expanding its partnership with SpaceX.”
He added that “SK Hynix/Intel could provide U.S.-based memory manufacturing capacity that complements Intel’s 14A process and advanced packaging business.”
SpaceX is jointly building a chip‑manufacturing facility in Austin, Texas with Tesla (TSLA-US), as the company believes semiconductor supply could ultimately become a bottleneck for AI growth.
SpaceX’s growth has repeatedly outpaced market expectations. The market projects SpaceX’s AI revenue to reach roughly $67 billion in 2027, up from a June estimate of $38 billion.
Wall Street now expects SpaceX’s AI revenue to hit about $275 billion by 2030, compared with a June forecast of roughly $110 billion.

According to Citi’s U.S. investment‑grade credit strategy head Daniel Sorid, as of the end of Q2 large cloud providers had backlog orders of about $2.5 trillion, a proxy for AI demand that grew about 100% year‑over‑year, far above the sub‑$500 billion level before ChatGPT’s launch at the end of 2022.
Q2 cloud revenue broke $100 billion for the first time, and data‑center capital spending also exceeded $100 billion for the first time.

Sustained AI demand is clearly a tailwind for SpaceX. The company had 1.4 GW of AI compute capacity at the end of Q2 (compute capacity is typically measured by the power needed to run it). SpaceX aims to reach up to 10 GW of AI compute power by the end of 2027.
Pinpointing the exact drivers behind SpaceX’s stock moves is difficult. Since its June IPO, the share has been volatile, hitting a high of $225.64 early on and a low of $104.83.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉Fed升息後美元六連漲止步 英鎊在央行按兵不動後走弱
items.title_en: <New York FX> Dollar’s Six-Day Rally Pauses After Fed Hike; Pound Weakens After BoE Holds Rates
paras: 美元周四(17日)暫停連續六個交易日的漲勢，此前一日美國聯準會(Fed)如市場普遍預期升息。市場焦點轉向英格蘭銀行(BoE)維持利率不變的決定，同時外匯交易員也為市場普遍預期的日本銀行(BoJ)收緊貨幣政策做準備。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)徘徊在100.23，略低於平盤。
美元在過去六個交易日累計上漲近1.5%，市場對聯準會升息的預期持續升溫。聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)周三符合市場預期，一致投票決定將聯邦資金利率從3.50%-3.75%上調至3.75%-4.00%。
升息決定公布後，美元指數一度觸及當日高點，因較高的利率環境通常有利於美元走強。
外匯市場參與者也消化了聯準會最新公布的經濟預測摘要以及聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)記者會所釋放的鷹派訊號。最新點陣圖顯示，至少有12名FOMC成員預期今年還會再升息一次。
華許則強調，美國潛在通膨趨勢並未出現有意義的改善，同時指出整體金融環境的限制程度仍不足，並再次強調聯準會致力於實現物價穩定。
華許告訴記者，「事實很清楚，通膨太高了，而且已經持續太久。」
根據CME FedWatch工具，10月再升息25個基點目前仍難以預料，市場認為這項升息的機率為55%。
英鎊在英國央行按兵不動後走弱 歐元小幅上漲
英鎊兌美元周四下跌0.2%，至1.3356美元。
稍早，英格蘭銀行貨幣政策委員會如市場預期，將基準利率維持在3.75%不變。不過，9名具投票權成員中有3人反對這項決定，主張升息25個基點。
委員會承認，中東衝突持續延長推升了英國通膨，但也表示，到目前為止，「幾乎沒有證據顯示價格與薪資制定出現實質性的第二輪效應」。
雖然委員會沒有直接提供未來可能升息的政策指引，但認為，相較於7月會議時，通膨前景面臨的風險更加偏向上行。
AJ Bell個人理財主管Sarah Coles表示，「不要因此感到安心。英格蘭銀行已經連續第六次維持利率不變，但市場越來越確信，未來可能會有多次升息。委員會或許暫停了升息，但市場預期接下來將快速轉向。」
同時，9月會議紀要顯示，委員們認為，「金融環境以及因此影響家庭與企業的利率，自衝突開始以來已經收緊，而且自7月以來進一步收緊」。
根據MUFG，英鎊下跌是因為部分交易員原本預期英格蘭銀行會釋放更加強硬的訊號。
由Henry Cook領導的MUFG分析師表示，「英格蘭銀行的政策更新比部分投資人擔心的更加溫和，導致英鎊與英國公債殖利率同步回落，因為委員會沒有釋放11月升息的訊號，並持續強調更加緊縮的金融環境已經有助於抑制通膨。」
日元走強 市場準備迎接日銀歷史性升息
日元走強，美元兌日元匯率下跌0.2%，至155.98。這項走勢發生在市場普遍預期日本銀行即將升息25個基點之前。
若升息成真，日本借貸成本將升至31年來最高水準，也代表日本將大幅告別持續數十年的超寬鬆貨幣政策。
日本銀行總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)正面對持續性的成本推動型通膨，而目前原油價格每桶超過100美元，更進一步加劇了通膨壓力。
LPL Financial首席經濟學家Jeffrey Roach表示，「昨天聯準會的決策，為即將召開的日本銀行會議帶來了一個非常有趣的政策動態。」
「這裡的拉扯在於，鷹派聯準會與正在收緊政策的日本銀行，正讓美元兌日元受到相反方向的力量拉扯：聯準會持續升息會推動美元走強，但隨著日本銀行政策正常化，日元則應該升值。」
Roach補充，「在日本銀行公布決策前，美元兌日元維持在155附近，接下來的淨變動將取決於日本銀行是否釋放加快升息步調的訊號。」
「如果日本銀行加快升息周期，可能推高全球公債殖利率，因為日本投資人會為了尋求更高的國內報酬率而將資金匯回日本。這種外溢效應可能進一步放大固定收益市場的壓力。」

paras_en: The dollar halted its six‑day winning streak on Thursday (the 17th), after the U.S. Federal Reserve (Fed) raised rates as broadly expected. Market focus shifted to the Bank of England’s (BoE) decision to keep rates unchanged, while forex traders also prepared for the widely anticipated tightening by the Bank of Japan (BoJ).
In late New York trading, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, hovered around 100.23, slightly below the flat line.

The dollar has risen nearly 1.5% over the past six trading sessions, as expectations for further Fed hikes have intensified. The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) on Wednesday voted unanimously, as markets expected, to lift the federal funds rate range from 3.50‑3.75% to 3.75‑4.00%.
After the rate‑rise announcement, the dollar index briefly touched its intraday high, since a higher‑rate environment typically favours a stronger dollar.

Forex participants also digested the Fed’s latest economic‑forecast summary and the hawkish signals released in Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s press conference. The newest dot‑plot shows at least 12 FOMC members expect another rate hike this year.

Warsh stressed that the underlying inflation trend in the United States has not shown any meaningful improvement, and he noted that overall financial‑market constraints remain insufficient, reiterating the Fed’s commitment to price stability.
Warsh told reporters, “The fact is clear – inflation is too high and has been too persistent.”
According to the CME FedWatch tool, a further 25‑basis‑point hike in October remains uncertain, with the market assigning a 55% probability to that move.
The pound weakened after the Bank of England held rates steady, while the euro edged higher.
The pound fell 0.2% against the dollar on Thursday, trading at $1.3356.

Earlier, the BoE’s Monetary Policy Committee, as markets expected, left the benchmark rate unchanged at 3.75%. However, three of the nine voting members voted against the decision, advocating a 25‑basis‑point increase.

The committee acknowledged that the prolonged Middle‑East conflict has pushed UK inflation higher, but said that so far “there is virtually no evidence of a substantive second‑round effect on prices and wages.”
Although the committee did not give explicit forward guidance on future hikes, it judged that inflation risks have tilted more to the upside compared with the July meeting.

AJ Bell personal‑finance head Sarah Coles said, “Don’t be complacent. The BoE has held rates steady for the sixth time in a row, but the market is increasingly convinced that multiple hikes could follow. The committee may have paused, but expectations are set to swing quickly.”

At the same time, the September minutes showed members believe “the financial environment and the resulting interest‑rate pressures on households and firms have tightened since the conflict began and have tightened further since July.”
MUFG said the pound’s drop stemmed from some traders originally expecting the BoE to issue a more forceful signal.

MUFG analyst Henry Cook, who led the note, explained, “The BoE’s policy update was milder than some investors feared, causing the pound and UK gilt yields to fall in tandem because the committee gave no signal of a November hike and kept stressing that a tighter financial environment is already helping to curb inflation.”
Yen Strengthens as Market Prepares for Historic BoJ Rate Hike
The yen rose, with the USD/JPY pair slipping 0.2% to 155.98, a move that came as markets broadly expected the Bank of Japan to raise rates by 25 basis points soon.
If the hike materialises, Japan’s borrowing costs will climb to the highest level in 31 years, marking a decisive break from decades of ultra‑easy policy.
Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda is confronting cost‑push inflation, while oil prices above $100 a barrel are adding further inflationary pressure.
LPL Financial chief economist Jeffrey Roach said, “Yesterday’s Fed decision creates a very interesting policy dynamic for the upcoming BoJ meeting.”
“The tug‑of‑war is that a hawkish Fed and a tightening BoJ are pulling the USD/JPY in opposite directions: continued Fed hikes boost the dollar, while BoJ normalisation should lift the yen.”
Roach added, “Before the BoJ announces its decision, the dollar‑yen sits around the 155 level; the net move will depend on whether the BoJ signals an accelerated hike pace.”

“If the BoJ speeds up its tightening cycle, it could push global sovereign yields higher, as Japanese investors repatriate funds to chase better domestic returns. That spill‑over could further stress fixed‑income markets.”

The dollar index was at 100.2211, down 0.0093%. The euro was at $1.1476, up 0.0087%. The pound was at $1.3351, down 0.0599%. The Australian dollar was at $0.7110, up 0.0141%. The USD/CAD was at 1.3992, up 0.0143%. The USD/JPY was at 155.9400, down 0.0064%.

items.title: 〈台幣〉股匯雙漲 中止連5黑收31.881元
items.title_en: TWD Dual Rise in Stocks and Forex, Ends Five-Day Decline, Closes at 31.881
paras: 美國聯準會(Fed)一如預期升息 1 碼，市場觀望台灣央行是否跟進，使得整體匯市交投冷清，新台幣兌美元匯率今(17)日一度失守 31.9 元，終場收在31.881元，微升0.7分，中止連 5 黑，台北外匯市場成交量 10.67 億美元。
Fed 升息利空出盡，台股今天開高走高，一度大漲千點，隨後漲幅收斂，終場上漲 439.1 點，收在 46288 點，站回月線。權王台積電終場上漲 45 元，收在 2425 元。外資回頭買超台股 121.85 億元。
台北股匯今天同步走揚，新台幣兌美元開盤價為31.91元，最高31.866元、最低31.958元，終場收在31.881元，微升0.7分。
Fed官員一致決議升息 1 碼，將基準利率調高至 3.75% 至 4%，為 2023 年 7 月以來首次升息。主席華許指出，升息主要基於三大關鍵因素，包括近期數據顯示美國基礎經濟成長超乎預期、勞動市場表現依然穩健，以及通膨持續居高不下且地緣政治局勢改變了經濟展望。FOMC 認為基礎通膨尚未明確朝 2% 目標下降，因此決定調高利率以展現壓制物價的決心。
最新點狀圖顯示，大多數官員預期年底前可能還會再升息 1 碼，但華許拒絕提供明確的前瞻指引，強調未來的政策行動將完全取決於最新經濟數據，保留後續調整彈性。此偏鷹派的表態直接衝擊金融市場，導致美股急跌翻黑、美債殖利率回升、美元大幅走強，黃金價格則隨之承壓重挫。
paras_en: The U.S. Federal Reserve raised rates by one quarter point as expected, and the market is watching whether Taiwan’s central bank will follow suit, leaving overall foreign‑exchange trading subdued. The New Taiwan dollar slipped past NT$31.9 per US$ on the 17th before finishing at NT$31.881, a modest rise of 0.7 points, ending a streak of five consecutive down days. The Taipei foreign‑exchange market saw a turnover of US$1.067 billion.

With the Fed’s rate hike fully priced in, Taiwan’s stock market opened higher and surged early, at one point jumping a thousand points before the gains narrowed. It closed up 439.1 points at 46,288, back above the monthly moving average. Chip‑maker TSMC added NT$45 to finish at NT$2,425. Foreign investors turned net buyers, purchasing NT$121.85 billion of Taiwanese equities.

The Taipei stock and forex markets rose in tandem today. The New Taiwan dollar opened at NT$31.91 per US$, peaked at NT$31.866, hit a low of NT$31.958, and closed at NT$31.881, a slight increase of 0.7 points.

Fed officials unanimously voted to raise the policy rate by one quarter point, moving the target range to 3.75%‑4%, the first hike since July 2023. Chair Jerome Powell said the move was driven by three key factors: recent data showing U.S. core economic growth exceeding expectations, a still‑robust labor market, and persistently high inflation amid changing geopolitical outlooks. The FOMC concluded that core inflation has not yet clearly moved toward the 2% goal, prompting the rate increase to demonstrate resolve on price stability.

The latest dot‑plot shows most officials expect another quarter‑point hike before year‑end, but Powell declined to give explicit forward guidance, stressing that future policy will depend entirely on incoming economic data and keeping flexibility for further adjustments. This hawkish tone hit financial markets hard, sending U.S. equities sharply lower, U.S. Treasury yields higher, the dollar stronger, and gold prices under pressure with a steep decline.

items.title: 〈央行理監事會〉利率連10凍、對房市鬆綁 楊金龍不跟進美國升息：走自己的路
items.title_en: <Central Bank Board Meeting> Interest Rates Frozen for the 10th Time, Housing Market Restrictions Eased; Governor Yang Jin‑long Won’t Follow U.S. Rate Hikes: Going Its Own Way
paras: 儘管美國聯準會甫宣布升息1碼(25個基點)，台灣是否跟進引發國內各界討論，但台灣央行今 (17) 日召開第三季理監事會議，仍宣布利率「連 10 凍」，央行總裁楊金龍說，「我們走我們的路」；同時，此次央行放鬆對房市的選擇性信用管制措施，調整自然人第2戶購屋貸款最高成數上限，由6成調升為7成。
央行發布最新重貼現率、擔保放款融通利率和短期融通利率分別為 2%、2.375% 和 4.25%，維持利率不變。
央行表示，今年國內通膨尚屬可控，明年可望回降至2%以下，同時，預期國內經濟穩健成長，為審慎因應全球經濟金融前景不確定性，以及中東衝突效應對國內物價與經濟可能影響，理事會認為本次維持政策利率不變，有助整體經濟金融穩健發展。
不過，楊金龍表示，將密切觀察國內通膨發展、主要經濟體貨幣政策緊縮程度、國內金融情勢，以及其他不確定性因素如AI應用前景、美國經貿政策衝擊及極端氣候等對國內經濟的影響，適時調整貨幣政策，以達成維持物價穩定和金融穩定。
外界解讀，此可能是後續央行啟動升息的訊號。
而美國聯準會周三(16日)宣布升息1碼，將基準利率上調至 3.75% 至 4.00% 區間，目標是緩和仍高於 2%的通膨壓力，美國總統川普對此表態，正面對一個「具敵意的理事會」。
paras_en: Despite the U.S. Federal Reserve’s recent 25‑basis‑point rate hike sparking debate in Taiwan over whether to follow suit, the Central Bank held its third‑quarter board meeting on the 17th and again announced that interest rates will remain frozen for the tenth consecutive meeting. Governor Yang Jin‑long said, “We will walk our own path.” At the same time, the bank relaxed selective credit controls on the housing market, raising the maximum loan‑to‑value ratio for a second home for individuals from 60% to 70%.
The Central Bank released its latest rates: the discount rate at 2.0%, the guaranteed loan financing rate at 2.375%, and the short‑term financing rate at 4.25%, leaving all rates unchanged.

The bank noted that domestic inflation remains manageable this year and is expected to fall below 2% next year. It also expects solid economic growth at home. To prudently address uncertainties in the global economic and financial outlook and the potential impact of Middle‑East conflicts on domestic prices and the economy, the board believes keeping the policy rate unchanged supports overall economic and financial stability.

Governor Yang added that the bank will closely monitor domestic inflation developments, the tightening of major economies’ monetary policies, domestic financial conditions, and other uncertain factors such as AI application prospects, U.S. trade policy shocks, and extreme weather, adjusting monetary policy as needed to maintain price and financial stability.
Observers interpret this as a possible signal that the Central Bank may initiate rate hikes in the future.

The U.S. Federal Reserve announced on Wednesday the 16th a 25‑basis‑point increase, raising the target range to 3.75%‑4.00% to ease inflation pressures that remain above 2%. President Trump commented on the move, describing the Fed as a “hostile board.”

items.title: 儘管通膨升溫 英國央行預計維持利率不變
items.title_en: Despite Rising Inflation, the Bank of England Expected to Keep Rates Unchanged
paras: 儘管英國8月消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率由7月的2.9%攀升至3.1%，進一步偏離英國央行設定的2%目標，市場普遍預期貨幣政策委員會(MPC)仍將以多數決將基準利率維持在3.75%，這將是央行連續第六次按兵不動。
本次通膨回升主要受到伊朗衝突引發的油氣價格飆漲，以及荷姆茲海峽航運受阻影響，推升了汽油與機票價格。隨著10月國內家庭能源帳單即將調漲，短期內物價壓力恐難緩解。
針對利率政策方向，專家與央行內部呈現明確分歧。施羅德全球經濟主管 David Rees 認為勞動市場與薪資成長依然溫和，他指出：「這應能限制進口價格壓力嵌入國內薪資與物價的程度」，因而支持央行暫時維持利率不變。
英國央行首席經濟學家 Huw Pill 則強烈反對「觀望態度」。他在演說中主張升息至4%，並警告：「不確定性可能無法如預期般快速解決，進而導致利率設定出現『現狀偏誤』，讓貨幣政策在因應通膨風險時『落後於曲線』」。此前，委員 Megan Greene 與 Catherine Mann 也曾投票支持升息至4%。
在美國聯準會(Fed)與歐洲央行(ECB)陸續調整政策之際，掉期市場預估英國央行可能於11月或12月啟動升息。由於首相柏南(Andy Burnham)政府將於10月底提出秋季預算案，央行傾向先觀察財政政策細節。而升息預期已帶動房貸利率上揚，也加重了政府的債務利息負擔。
paras_en: Despite the UK’s August Consumer Price Index (CPI) annual rate climbing from 2.9% in July to 3.1%, further away from the Bank of England’s 2% target, markets broadly expect the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) to vote overwhelmingly to keep the Bank Rate at 3.75%, marking the sixth consecutive meeting of policy hold.

The latest inflation bounce is mainly driven by soaring oil and gas prices triggered by the Iran conflict and shipping disruptions in the Hormuz Strait, which have pushed up gasoline and airfare costs. With domestic household energy bills set to rise in October, price pressures are unlikely to ease in the short term.

On the direction of rate policy, experts and insiders at the Bank show a clear split. David Rees, Global Head of Economics at Schroders, argues that the labour market and wage growth remain moderate, noting, “This should limit the extent to which imported price pressures feed into domestic wages and inflation,” and therefore backs a temporary pause on rate hikes.

Bank of England chief economist Huw Pill strongly opposes a “wait‑and‑see” stance. In his speech he advocated raising rates to 4% and warned, “Uncertainty may not be resolved as quickly as expected, leading to a ‘status‑quo bias’ in rate setting that could leave monetary policy lagging behind the inflation curve.” Previously, MPC members Megan Greene and Catherine Mann also voted for a hike to 4%.

As the US Federal Reserve and the European Central Bank adjust their policies, the swaps market estimates the Bank of England could start raising rates in November or December. Since Prime Minister Andy Burnham’s government will present its autumn budget at the end of October, the Bank prefers to first observe fiscal details. The rate‑rise expectations have already pushed up mortgage rates, adding to the government’s debt‑service burden.

items.title: 聯準會鷹派升息重壓日元 日本央行面臨「走鋼索」考驗
items.title_en: Fed's Hawkish Rate Hikes Pressure Yen; BOJ Faces a "Tightrope" Test
paras: 美國聯準會周三(16日)升息，並預估明年年中前將再升息三次，導致美日利差持續擴大，重挫日元走勢。儘管日本央行(BOJ)預計於周五升息，但市場警告，若官方未能釋出明確的緊縮訊號，日元恐將進一步受挫。
在聯準會決議後，美元兌日元一度貶至 156.42。墨爾本 ACCM 研究總監 Glenn Yin 指出，日本正面臨巨大壓力，必須同時升息並傳遞鷹派訊息以減輕損害；若日本央行政策令人失望，匯率快速下探 160 關卡將是無法排除的風險。
目前隔夜指數交換(OIS)已幾乎完全反映升息 1 碼(25 個基點)的預期，焦點轉向總裁植田和男會後的發言，鷹派審議委員高田創對大幅升息或連續升息抱持開放態度。
SMBC 日興證券高級策略師Rinto Maruyama指出，日元回落與油價上漲為官方強調通膨風險提供了理由，但若會議被解讀為鴿派，美元兌日元下一目標將看 158，長期不排除重返 160。
青空銀行(Aozora Bank)首席市場策略師Akira Moroga警告，日本央行的緊縮立場可能不如聯準會鷹派，這恐成為日元弱勢的即時催化劑，下個關鍵門檻落在 200 日均線附近的 158.50。
此外，匯市干預風險再次升溫。日本財務省數據顯示，截至 8 月 26 日止的一個月中，日本耗資創紀錄的 15.4 兆日元進行干預，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)持續釋出支持強勢日元的訊號。
花旗集團策略師Osamu Takashima等人認為，雖然短期美元兌日元可能反彈至 159，但長期而言，多次干預與日本國債吸引力提升將推動體制轉變，日元拋售潮預計將不如過往激烈。
paras_en: The U.S. Federal Reserve raised rates on Wednesday (the 16th) and projected three more hikes before mid‑next year, widening the U.S.–Japan interest‑rate gap and sharply weakening the yen. Although the Bank of Japan (BOJ) is expected to raise rates on Friday, markets warn that if the BOJ fails to deliver a clear tightening signal, the yen could be hit even harder.

After the Fed decision, the dollar fell as low as ¥156.42 per dollar. Glenn Yin, research director at Melbourne‑based ACCM, said Japan is under huge pressure and must raise rates while sending a hawkish message to limit damage; if BOJ policy disappoints, a rapid slide toward the ¥160 barrier cannot be ruled out.

Overnight indexed swap (OIS) rates now almost fully price in a one‑tick (25‑basis‑point) hike, shifting focus to the remarks of Governor Kazuo Ueda after the meeting, while hawkish committee member Hiroshi Takata remains open to large or consecutive hikes.

Rinto Maruyama, senior strategist at SMBC Nikko Securities, noted that the yen’s decline and rising oil prices give officials a reason to stress inflation risks, but if the meeting is read as dovish, the next target for USD/JPY will be around 158, with a long‑term possibility of returning to 160.

Akira Moroga, chief market strategist at Aozora Bank, warned that the BOJ’s tightening stance may be less hawkish than the Fed’s, which could become an immediate catalyst for yen weakness, with the next critical threshold near the 200‑day moving average at ¥158.50.

In addition, the risk of currency‑market intervention has risen again. Ministry of Finance data show that in the month ending August 26, Japan spent a record ¥15.4 trillion on interventions, while U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent continues to signal support for a stronger yen.

Citigroup strategists led by Osamu Takashima believe that although the dollar‑yen pair may bounce to ¥159 in the short term, in the longer run repeated interventions and the growing appeal of Japanese government bonds will drive a structural shift, and the yen‑selling pressure is expected to be less intense than in the past.

items.title: 香港金管局隨Fed上調基本利率 余偉文：民眾需充分考量並管理利率風險
items.title_en: Hong Kong Monetary Authority Raises Base Rate in Line with Fed; Yu Wai-man Says Public Must Fully Consider and Manage Interest Rate Risk
paras: 美國聯準會(Fed)周三(16日)宣布上調聯邦基金利率目標區間25個基點至3.75%—4.00%後，香港金融管理局(金管局)隨即宣布，依據預設公式將基本利率上調25個基點至4.25%，即時生效。
金管局此舉旨在緊貼美方升息步伐，以維持港元聯繫匯率制度。
然而，香港主要商業銀行包括滙豐銀行、中國銀行(香港)及渣打銀行(香港)均宣布維持港元最優惠利率不變，分別保持在5%與5.25%。不過，滙豐自9月18日起將美元儲蓄存款戶口利率上調12.4個基點至0.125%。
針對升息影響，金管局總裁余偉文表示，上調利率符合市場預期。他分析，港美息差進一步擴大可能引發套利交易，導致港元逐步走弱。余偉文特別提醒，美國利率走向仍具不確定性，民眾在做出購屋房貸、投資或借貸決定時，需充分考量並管理利率風險。
中銀香港高級經濟研究員曾之騰指出，本次升息已獲市場充分定價，聲明顯示聯準會正更加聚焦於通膨偏離目標的幅度與持續時間；同時美債長端殖利率「易上難下」，需警惕其推高全球融資成本的風險。
奧雅納董事王兆麒認為，升息將增加現有購屋族負擔並削弱購買力，部分準買家或將「轉買為租」。他預估香港房市下半年將出現「價量齊跌」，2026年餘下時間房價將反覆向下。
嘉信理財香港高級副總裁林長傑補充，本次決策顯示聯準會傾向預先抑制通膨風險，市場原先預期於2027年啟動降息循環的可能性正隨之下降。
paras_en: The U.S. Federal Reserve announced on Wednesday (the 16th) that it is raising the target range for the federal funds rate by 25 basis points to 3.75%‑4.00%, and the Hong Kong Monetary Authority immediately announced that, according to its preset formula, the base rate will be raised by 25 basis points to 4.25% and will take effect instantly.
The move by the Monetary Authority is intended to stay closely aligned with the U.S. rate‑hiking pace in order to maintain the linked exchange‑rate system for the Hong Kong dollar.

However, Hong Kong’s major commercial banks—including HSBC, Bank of China (Hong Kong) and Standard Chartered Bank (Hong Kong) – have all said they will keep their best‑rate HKD lending rates unchanged at 5% and 5.25% respectively. HSBC, however, will raise the interest rate on its U.S. dollar savings accounts by 12.4 basis points to 0.125% starting September 18.

Regarding the rate‑hike impact, Monetary Authority chief executive Yu Wai-man said the increase is in line with market expectations. He warned that a further widening of the HK‑US interest‑rate spread could trigger arbitrage trades that would gradually weaken the Hong Kong dollar. Yu stressed that the trajectory of U.S. rates remains uncertain, and that the public should fully consider and manage interest‑rate risk when making decisions about home mortgages, investments or borrowing.

Bank of China (Hong Kong) senior economist Zeng Zhiteng noted that the hike has already been fully priced in by the market, indicating that the Fed is focusing more on the magnitude and duration of inflation deviating from its target; at the same time, long‑term U.S. Treasury yields are “easy to rise but hard to fall,” and the risk that they could push up global financing costs should be watched.

O’Yana director Wang Zhaoqi believes the rate increase will increase the burden on existing home‑buyers and erode purchasing power, causing some prospective buyers to “switch from buying to renting.” He forecasts that Hong Kong’s housing market will see “price and volume falling together” in the second half of the year, and that house prices will continue to decline intermittently through the remainder of 2026.

Charles Schwab Hong Kong senior vice‑president Lin Changjie added that the decision shows the Fed’s inclination to pre‑emptively curb inflation risk, reducing the market’s earlier expectation of a rate‑cut cycle starting in 2027.

items.title: 日銀跟進Fed升1碼已計價！專家：支撐日元面臨更高門檻 明天會後指引若不鷹恐再測160
items.title_en: BOJ Follows Fed’s 1‑Basis‑Point Hike Already Priced In! Experts Say Support for Yen Faces Higher Hurdles; If Post‑Meeting Guidance Isn’t Hawkish, Yen May Test 160 Again
paras: 聯準會(Fed)週三(16日)宣布將聯邦基金利率目標區間升息1碼至3.75%-4%，為2023年7月以來首見且釋出進一步緊縮訊號，市場已將明年年中前再升息3次納入預期，對此專家認為Fed最新舉措將讓週五(19日)日本央行(BOJ)升息支撐日元面臨更高門檻。
日元在美元走強下隔夜一度走貶近1%，觸及156.42。匯市策略師指出，即便BOJ按市場共識升息1碼，但若會後指引不夠鷹派，仍難抵銷美日利差擴大壓力。
墨爾本ACCM研究總監Glenn Yin表示，日本央行「既要升息、又要釋出鷹派信號」才能把日元損失降到最低，若結果令市場失望，短期向下測試160風險難除。
隔夜指數掉期數據幾乎完全反映1碼升幅，市場重心轉向BOJ總裁植田和男記者會。
鷹派審議委員高田創未排除大幅或連續加息；三井住友日興證券Rinto Maruyama則認為，預期升息後政策利率可進入中性區間估算值(約1.1%-2.5%)，因此BOJ不太可能暗示一次升息2碼或連續升，但若被解讀偏鴿，美元兌日元匯率將攀升至158，中長期若美債殖利率升速快於日本，則可能上看160。油價上漲推升輸入型通膨，也給BOJ強調通膨上行風險提供理由。
不過，新一輪賣壓恐低於以往。根據CFTC數據顯示，在8日為止一週，槓桿交易員日元空頭較前期減半，套利交易因本月初日元反彈已部分平倉，日本退休基金回補國內資產的預期亦降低單邊做空意願。美日聯合干預的威脅同樣形成下限，美國財長貝森特持續釋出支持日元走強訊號。
青空銀行首席市場策略師諸岡晃(Akira Moroga)則提醒，BOJ很難採取與Fed同等鷹派立場，若僅溫和升息、缺乏後續路徑，158.5(接近200日線)將成下個關鍵。
整體來看，明日決議本身已大致被市場消化，真正主導日元的是總裁植田和男記者會對未來每季緊縮節奏的表態，以及美日利差重新定價的速度。
paras_en: The Federal Reserve announced on Wednesday (the 16th) that it will raise the target range for the federal funds rate by one basis point to 3.75%‑4%, the first hike since July 2023 and a signal of further tightening. Markets have already priced in three more hikes by mid‑next year, and experts say the Fed’s latest move will raise the bar for the Bank of Japan’s (BOJ) rate hike on Friday (the 19th) to support the yen.

The yen slipped nearly 1% overnight against a strengthening dollar, touching 156.42. Currency strategists note that even if the BOJ raises rates by one basis point in line with market consensus, a post‑meeting outlook that is not sufficiently hawkish will still struggle to offset the pressure from a widening US‑Japan rate differential.

Glenn Yin, research director at Melbourne’s ACCM, said the BOJ “needs to raise rates and send a hawkish signal” to minimise the yen’s losses. If the outcome disappoints the market, the risk of a short‑term test of the 160 level remains hard to dismiss.
Overnight index swap data almost fully reflected the one‑basis‑point hike, shifting market focus to BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda’s press conference.

Hawkish policy‑board member Hiroshi Nakata did not rule out a large or consecutive rate increase; Mitsui Sumitomo Nikko Securities’ Rinto Maruyama believes that after a hike the policy rate could enter a neutral range (about 1.1%‑2.5%), so the BOJ is unlikely to signal a two‑basis‑point move or a series of hikes. However, if the tone is read as dovish, the USD/JPY rate could climb to 158, and in the medium‑to‑long term, if US Treasury yields rise faster than Japan’s, it could push toward 160. Rising oil prices are feeding import‑linked inflation, giving the BOJ further reason to stress upside inflation risks.

Nevertheless, the new round of selling pressure may be lower than before. CFTC data show that in the week ending the 8th, leveraged traders’ yen short positions were halved from the prior period, and arbitrage trades have been partially unwound after the yen’s rebound earlier this month. Expectations that Japanese pension funds will rebalance into domestic assets have also reduced unilateral short‑selling appetite. The threat of coordinated US‑Japan intervention also sets a floor, with US Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen continuing to signal support for a stronger yen.

Akira Moroga, chief market strategist at Aozora Bank, cautions that the BOJ can hardly adopt a stance as hawkish as the Fed’s. If it only delivers a modest hike without a clear forward path, the 158.5 level (near the 200‑day moving average) will become the next key threshold.

Overall, tomorrow’s decision has largely been priced in by the market. What will truly drive the yen is Governor Ueda’s press conference and his comments on the quarterly tightening pace, as well as the speed at which the US‑Japan rate differential is re‑priced.

items.title: 高盛改口！預期聯準會10月再升息25個基點 年底利率看向4%-4.25%
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Reverses Stance, Anticipates Another 25‑Basis‑Point Rate Hike by the Fed in October, Year‑End Rates Targeted at 4%‑4.25%
paras: 高盛集團最新調整利率預測，現在預期美國聯準會將於10月政策會議再次升息25個基點，延續9月升息的步伐。高盛在最新報告中指出，10月是下一次升息最可能發生的時間點，因為聯準會若要透過連續會議升息，讓通膨更及時回到2%目標，10月將是較自然的政策行動時機。
聯準會周三(16日)宣布升息25個基點，將聯邦基金利率目標區間由3.50%-3.75%提高至3.75%-4.00%，這是聯準會自2023年7月以來首次升息。聯準會同時釋放未來數月可能進一步升息的訊號，顯示決策官員認為通膨仍處於偏高水準，政策仍需維持緊縮方向。
高盛目前預期，聯準會將在9月及10月連續兩次升息25個基點，使聯邦基金利率升至4.00%-4.25%。高盛認為，這樣的連續升息路徑符合聯準會希望讓通膨更及時回到2%目標的政策訊息，因此10月比12月更可能成為下一次升息時點。
聯準會最新公布的經濟預測也支持進一步升息的可能性。最新利率點陣圖顯示，政策制定者預期今年還會升息1次，之後在2027年維持利率不變，2028年才重新降息，2029年底聯邦基金利率預估落在3.50%-3.75%。
最新預測與6月時的政策展望相比出現變化。6月時，聯準會官員同樣預期2026年還有一次25個基點升息，但當時預估2027年還會降息25個基點；最新預測則改為今年再升息一次、2027年維持利率不變，反映決策官員對通膨降溫速度的預期更加謹慎。
通膨前景是聯準會重新轉向升息的重要原因。聯準會最新預測顯示，2026年個人消費支出價格指數(PCE)通膨率中位數預測由6月的3.6%上修至3.7%，2027年預估為2.3%，2028年為2.1%，並預計到2029年才回到2%的長期目標。
聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)表示，通膨仍然過高，而且持續時間太長，夏季公布的通膨數據並未顯示核心通膨趨勢出現明顯改善。因此，聯準會目前仍將控制通膨視為主要政策焦點。
除了通膨之外，美國經濟活動仍具韌性，也降低聯準會立即放鬆政策的必要性。聯準會最新聲明指出，美國經濟活動仍以穩健速度擴張，生產力成長強勁，企業資本投資也保持韌性，這些因素使決策官員仍有空間維持較高利率。
聯準會最新經濟預測也顯示，政策制定者對經濟成長的看法略為改善，同時預期失業率仍維持在相對低的水準。在通膨尚未回到2%目標、經濟活動又沒有出現明顯疲弱的情況下，聯準會因此保留進一步升息的政策選項。
市場對再次升息的預期也快速升溫。聯準會公布利率決策及最新經濟預測後，投資人進一步押注今年底前仍有一次升息，利率市場的定價顯示，市場對聯準會持續收緊貨幣政策的預期明顯提高。
金融市場對9月升息的反應也相當明顯。聯準會公布決策後，美元走強，美國短天期公債殖利率上升，因2年期殖利率對聯準會政策利率預期最為敏感；長天期美債殖利率則相對穩定，使殖利率曲線進一步趨平。
高盛此次調整預測的關鍵，在於聯準會的政策討論已從是否開始升息，轉向下一次升息何時發生。由於9月升息已經實現，市場接下來將更加關注10月會議前公布的通膨、就業及經濟活動數據，尤其是價格壓力是否持續高於聯準會目標。
聯準會最新政策路徑也意味著高利率可能維持更長時間。最新預測顯示，2027年聯邦基金利率可能維持在4.00%-4.25%，2028年才開始回落，2029年底則預估降至3.50%-3.75%。這代表即使未來進入降息階段，利率仍可能長時間高於過去超低利率環境。
不過，華許並未提供自己的利率及經濟預測，他在會後記者會上強調，聯準會公布的經濟預測反映其他政策制定者的看法，而非他個人的預測，也沒有提供明確的前瞻性政策指引。因此，10月是否升息仍將取決於未來數週公布的經濟數據，而非目前任何單一機構的預測。
聯準會此次升息決策獲得一致支持，華許也加入投票。聯準會表示，通膨仍然偏高，且經濟活動保持穩健，因此需要進一步觀察政策對經濟及物價的影響。
在此背景下，高盛目前認為10月再次升息的可能性高於此前預期。若聯準會確實連續兩次升息，10月底聯邦基金利率將達到4.00%-4.25%，也將進一步確認美國貨幣政策重新進入緊縮階段。市場接下來將密切觀察通膨能否出現更明顯的降溫跡象，以及勞動市場與消費活動是否仍足以支撐聯準會延續升息路徑。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs Group has revised its rate outlook, now expecting the U.S. Federal Reserve to raise rates by another 25 basis points at its October policy meeting, continuing the pace set in September. In its latest report, Goldman notes that October is the most likely timing for the next hike, as a series of rate increases would help bring inflation back to the 2% target more promptly, making October a natural policy action point.

The Fed announced on Wednesday (the 16th) a 25‑basis‑point hike, moving the federal‑funds target range from 3.50%‑3.75% to 3.75%‑4.00%, its first increase since July 2023. The central bank also signaled that further hikes may follow in the coming months, indicating that policymakers still see inflation as elevated and that a tightening stance remains necessary.

Goldman now expects the Fed to deliver two consecutive 25‑basis‑point hikes in September and October, lifting the federal‑funds rate to 4.00%‑4.25%. The firm argues that this back‑to‑back path aligns with the Fed’s message of getting inflation back to 2% more quickly, making October more likely than December for the next move.

The Fed’s latest economic projections also support the possibility of further tightening. The newest dot‑plot shows policymakers anticipating one more hike this year, holding rates steady through 2027, with a first cut not expected until 2028, and a projected federal‑funds range of 3.50%‑3.75% by the end of 2029.

Compared with the June outlook, the latest forecast shows a shift. In June, officials expected another 25‑basis‑point hike in 2026 and a 25‑basis‑point cut in 2027. The new outlook replaces the 2027 cut with a rate‑hold, reflecting a more cautious view of how quickly inflation will cool.

Inflation outlook is a key driver of the Fed’s renewed tightening. The latest forecast raises the median personal consumption expenditures (PCE) inflation estimate for 2026 from 3.6% to 3.7%, with 2.3% projected for 2027, 2.1% for 2028, and a return to the 2% long‑run goal only by 2029.

Fed Chair Kevin Warsh said inflation remains too high and has persisted for too long; the summer inflation data did not show a clear improvement in core inflation trends. Consequently, controlling inflation remains the Fed’s primary policy focus.

Beyond inflation, U.S. economic activity remains resilient, reducing the need for an immediate policy easing. The Fed’s latest statement notes that the economy is expanding at a solid pace, productivity growth is strong, and corporate capital investment stays robust, giving policymakers room to keep rates elevated.

The Fed’s new economic projections also show a modest improvement in growth outlook and an expectation that unemployment will stay relatively low. With inflation still above the 2% target and no clear signs of economic weakness, the Fed retains the option of further hikes.

Market expectations for another hike have risen sharply. After the Fed released its rate decision and projections, investors doubled down on the view that another increase is likely before year‑end, and rate‑market pricing reflects a markedly higher expectation of continued monetary tightening.

Financial markets reacted noticeably to the September hike. Following the decision, the dollar strengthened and short‑term U.S. Treasury yields rose, with the two‑year yield being most sensitive to Fed policy expectations; longer‑term yields stayed relatively stable, flattening the yield curve further.

The key to Goldman’s forecast adjustment is that the Fed’s discussion has shifted from whether to start tightening to when the next hike will occur. With the September hike already priced in, markets will now focus on inflation, employment and activity data released before the October meeting, especially whether price pressures remain above the Fed’s target.

The Fed’s latest policy path also implies that high rates could persist longer. The new outlook suggests the federal‑funds rate may stay at 4.00%‑4.25% through 2027, only beginning to fall in 2028, and projected at 3.50%‑3.75% by the end of 2029. This means that even when the easing cycle starts, rates could remain well above the ultra‑low levels of recent years.

However, Warsh did not provide his own rate or economic forecasts; in his post‑meeting press conference he emphasized that the Fed’s projections reflect the views of other policymakers, not his personal outlook, and offered no explicit forward guidance. Thus, the October decision will depend on the economic data released in the coming weeks rather than any single institution’s forecast.

The rate‑hike decision received unanimous support from the Fed, with Warsh also voting. The Fed noted that inflation remains elevated and economic activity stays solid, warranting further observation of how policy impacts the economy and prices.

Against this backdrop, Goldman now sees a higher probability of another October hike than previously expected. If the Fed does deliver two consecutive hikes, the federal‑funds rate could reach 4.00%‑4.25% by the end of October, confirming that U.S. monetary policy has re‑entered a tightening phase. Markets will closely watch for clearer signs of inflation cooling and whether the labor market and consumer activity remain strong enough to sustain the Fed’s hike trajectory.
